sa: सा तु तत्रैव सम्भ्रान्ता सुव्रता वाक्यमब्रवीत्। एकपत्नीव्रतमिदं को नाशयितुमिच्छति॥
en: There influenced by fear, that one of excellent vows said,-no is it that desireth to lay violent hands upon my chastity?

sa: सर्वथा कुशलं सूत दुर्लभं मम बन्धुषु। तथा ह्यसति सम्मोहे हृदयं सीदतीव मे॥
en: O charioteer, complete good fortune with my friends is hardly to be realised. But although no apparent cause exists for my depression of spirits, yet my heart droopeth.

sa: निष्कूजमिव भूत्वेदं वनं घोरप्रदर्शनम्। अयोध्येव जनाकीर्णा सम्प्रति प्रतिभाति मे॥
en: And this forest, although void of men and dreadful in appearance, at present appears to me like Ayodhyā teeming with people.

sa: तद् वचः पितुरेवाहं सम्मतं धर्मचारिणाम्। कर्मणा पालयिष्यामि वनवासेन राघव॥
en: O descendant of Raghu, that mandate of our righteous father, acceptable to me, will I obey by abiding in the woods.

sa: चिरं जीवतु धर्मात्मा राजा दशरथोऽनघः। यत्प्रसादेनाभिषिक्तं रामं द्रक्ष्यामहे वयम्॥
en: May the sinless and pious king Dasaratha live long; for it is through his grace that we shall behold Rāma installed.

sa: नैनं दुःखेन संतप्तः प्रत्यवैक्षत राघवम्। न चैनमभिसम्प्रेक्ष्य प्रत्यभाषत दुर्मनाः॥
en: And burning in grief, the king could not eye Rāghava, nor seeing him could that one of arilicted mind answer anything.

sa: ततो वसिष्ठप्रमुखाः सर्व एव द्विजोत्तमाः। ऋष्यशृङ्गं पुरस्कृत्य यज्ञकर्मारभंस्तदा॥ यज्ञवाटं गताः सर्वे यथाशास्त्रं यथाविधि। श्रीमांश्च सह पत्नीभी राजा दीक्षामुपाविशत्॥
en: Then, with, Rsyasrriga at their head, Vasistha and the other principal Brāhmaṇas wending to the sacrificial ground, began the ceremony, according to the ordinance; and in due form. And the auspicious king, in company with his wives, was initiated into the ceremony.

sa: चिरस्य बत पश्यामि दूराद् भरतमागतम्। दुष्प्रतीकमरण्येऽस्मिन् किं तात वनमागतः॥
en: Ah! I see you come from far after a long time. Why, my child, have you come to this gloomy forest?

sa: चतुर्भिर्वेगसम्पनैर्हयैः काञ्चनभूषणैः। मुख्यः पुष्परथो युक्तः किं न गच्छति तेऽग्रतः॥
en: Why does not that excellent sport-chariot go before you, having four fast going steeds, adorned with golden ornaments tied to it?

sa: तं स्यन्दनमधिष्ठाय राघवः सपरिच्छदः। शीघ्रगामाकुलावर्ती तमसामतरत्रदीम्॥
en: Ascending the car after equipping himself, Rāghava crossed the rapidly-rushing Tamasā abounding in eddies.

sa: अन्त:पुराणि सर्वाणि शान्तां दृष्ट्वा तथागताम्। सह भ; विशालाक्षीं प्रीत्यानन्दमुपागमन्॥
en: And all the inmates of the inner apartment, seeing the large-eyed Săntă thus arrived with her husband, experienced excess of joy.

sa: त्वं हि देववरिष्ठस्य मारुतस्य महात्मनः। पुत्रस्तस्यैव वेगेन सदृशः कपिकुञ्जर॥
en: O you lion among monkeys, you are the son of Māruta, the foremost of celestials and are his equal in speed.

sa: पपात चरणौ तस्यास्तदा सम्भ्रान्तचेतनः। विलप्य बहुधासंज्ञो लब्धसंज्ञस्तदाभवत्॥ एवं विलपमानां तां प्राञ्जलिर्भरतस्तदा। कौसल्या प्रत्युवाचेदं शोकैर्बहुभिरावृताम् ॥
en: Exceedingly agitated, he fell at Kausalya's feet, lamenting much, and well nigh deprived of his Bharata then regained his consciousness, and with joined hands answered Kausalya lamenting thus and overcome with excess of sorrow, saying.

sa: ततः पञ्चवटीं गत्वा नानाव्यालमृगायुताम्। उवाच लक्ष्मणं रामो भ्रातरं दीप्ततेजसम्॥
en: Then repairing to Pañcavațī filled with various animals and beasts of prey, Rāma remarked to his brother Laksmana of flaming energy,

sa: ऊचुश्च परमायत्ता रामं ज्वलिततेजसम्। वत्स नैवं नियुक्तेयं वनवासे मनस्विनी॥
en: And waxing exceedingly aggrieved, they spoke to Rāma flaming in effulgence:, Child, do not take this virtuous one to the forest.

sa: हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि शृणु तत्त्वेन राघव। यस्यैतदाश्रमपदं शप्तं कोपान्महात्मनः॥
en: Ah! Do you listen. I will tell you through the wrath of what high-souled one this hermitage came to he cursed.

sa: लक्ष्मणेनैवमुक्ता तु क्रुद्धा संरक्तलोचना॥ अब्रवीत् परुषं वाक्यं लक्ष्मणं सत्यवादिनम्।
en: Being thus addressed by him her eyes were reddened with ire, and she spake these harsh words to the truthful Lakşmaņa.

sa: प्रत्याश्वस्ते जने तस्मिन् राजा विगतसाध्वसः। उवाच प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं वाक्यज्ञो मुनिपुङ्गवम्॥
en: On the people being reassured, the king conversant with speech, his apprehension removed, with folded hands addressed that puissant ascetic, saying.

sa: गुहासमीरणो गन्धान् नानापुष्पभवान् बहून्। घ्राणतर्पणमभ्येत्य के नरं न प्रहर्षयेत्॥
en: Whom does not the breeze laden with the perfumes of many a flower, soothing the sense of smell, fill with delight?

sa: भवतोऽनुमते ब्रह्मशीघ्रं गच्छन्तु मन्त्रिणः। मम कौशिक भद्रं ते अयोध्यां त्वरिता रथैः. :.२४॥ राजानं प्रश्रितैर्वाक्यैरानयन्तु पुरं मम। प्रदानं वीर्यशुल्कायाः कथयन्तु च सर्वशः॥
en: O Brāhmaṇa, by your permission let my counsellors speedily post hence, O Kausika, to Ayodhyā, in cars; and with humble speech bring the king to my capital. And let them communicate to him all about the bestowal of Sītå upon Răma, in consequence of his having bent the bow.

sa: त्वं तु को वा किमर्थं वा कवन्धसदृशो वने। आस्येनोरसि दीप्तेन भग्नजङ्घो विचेष्टसे॥
en: Who are you? And what for are you ranging this forest like to a headless demon, having your thighs broken and your flaming face placed on your breast?

sa: अम्बां च केकयीं रुष्य भरतश्चाप्रियं वदन्। प्रसाद्य पितरं श्रीमान् राज्यं मे दातुमागतः॥
en: And having got wroth with Kaikeyī, and given her rough speech, that auspicious one, having gratified my sire, has come hither to make the kingdom over to me.

sa: ततो रात्र्यां व्यतीतायां सोपाध्यायः सबान्धवः। राजा दशरथो हृष्टः सुमन्त्रमिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Then when the night had been spent, king Dasaratha accompanied with his priests and adherents, well pleased spoke to Sumantra, saying,

sa: यावज्जीवति काकुत्थः पिता मे जगतीपतिः। शुश्रूषा क्रियतां तावत् स हि धर्मः सनातनः॥
en: Do you serve this descendant of Kākutstha, my father, and the lord of the earth as long as he lives, know you this to be the eternal virtue

sa: यं मुहूर्तमपश्यंस्तु न जीवे तमहं ध्रुवम्। तेन रामेण कैकेयि शपे ते वचनक्रियाम्।७।।
en: By that Rāma, Kaikeyī, whom if I do not see for a moment, I die for certain, do I swear that whatever that will say I will accomplish.

sa: पश्य लक्ष्मण गृध्रोऽयमुपकारी हतश्च मे। सीतामभ्यवपन्नो हि रावणेन बलीयसा॥
en: Observe, O Laksmana, this vulture for my benefaction, has been killed by the powerful Rāvaņa in his attempt to rescue Sītā.

sa: त्वां चैवोपगताः सर्वे परिघुना बुभुक्षिताः। आतिथ्यधर्मदत्तानि मूलानि च फलानि च॥ अस्माभिरुपयुक्तानि बुभुक्षापरिपीडितैः।
en: Having come to you, hungry, and exhausted, we, who had been sore tried by hunger, have been entertained with fruits and roots, agreeably to the code regulating hospitality.

sa: तदलं कालसङ्गेन क्रियतां बुद्धिनिश्चयः। नहि कर्मसु सज्जन्ते बुद्धिमन्तो भवद्विधाः॥
en: There is no need of delay. Make up 'yo minds. Persons like you do not give way to laziness in enterprise.

sa: गम्यतां कार्यसिद्धयर्थमिति तावब्रवीत् स च॥ सुप्रीतौ तावनुज्ञाप्य कबन्धः प्रस्थितस्तदा॥
en: Whereto Kabandha replied, saying Do you proceed to make good your end and bidding them adieu, who were well pleased, departed.

sa: सौमित्रिरपि ताः सर्वा मातृः सम्प्रेक्ष्य दुःखितः। अभ्यवादयदासक्तं शनै रामादनन्तरम्॥
en: After Rāma had done, Sumitrā's son also, seeing all his mothers, with sorrow gently paid his reverence to them with affection.

sa: यथा त्वय्यङ्गदो नित्यं वर्तते वानरेश्वरः। तथा वर्तेत सुग्रीवे मयि चापि न संशयः॥
en: There is not the least doubt, lord of monkeys, that Angada shall be brought up by me and Sugriva in the same way as he was by you.

sa: प्रहसन्तीव राजानं प्रमदा रक्तवासिनी। प्रकर्षन्ती मया दृष्टा राक्षसी विकृतानना॥
en: And women clad in red garment were laughing at him, and a grim-visaged Rākşasa was seen by me as dragging him.

sa: रघोस्तु पुत्रस्तेजस्वी प्रवृद्धः पुरुषादकः। कल्माषपादः सौदास इत्येवं प्रथितो भुवि॥
en: Raghu's son is the energetic Pravědha, who are human beings. He is known on earth under such names as Kalmāşapāda, Saudāsa.

sa: कच्चित् ते दयिताः सर्वे कृषिगोरक्षजीविनः। वार्तायां संश्रितस्तात लोकोऽयं सुखमेधते॥
en: And do agriculturists and cow herds find favour in your sight? And remaining in their respective vocations, do they enjoy happiness?

sa: पश्य लक्ष्मण वैदेह्याः स्पृहामुल्लसितामिमाम्। रूपश्रेष्ठतया ह्येष मृगोऽद्य न भविष्यति॥
en: Behold, O Laksmana, it has immensely excited Vaidehi's desire. On account of its exquisite beauty it shall loose its life to-day.

sa: अथ शैलाद् विनिष्क्रम्य मैथिली कोशलेश्वरः। अदर्शयच्छुभजलां रम्यां मन्दाकिनी नदीम्॥
en: Then going out of the mountain, the Lord of Kosala showed to Mithila's daughter the charming stream Mandākini of excellent waters.

sa: यस्तु राजा स्थितोऽधर्मे मित्राणामुपकारिणाम्। मिथ्या प्रतिज्ञां कुरुते को नृशंसतरस्ततः॥
en: And who is more wicked than that king who, rooted in unrighteousness, makes false promises to friends intent upon his welfare?

sa: न्यग्रोधं समुपागम्य वैदेही चाभ्यवन्दत। नमस्तेऽस्तु महावृक्ष पारयेन्मे पतिव्रतम्॥ कौसल्यां चैव पश्येम सुमित्रां च यशस्विनीम्। इति सीताञ्जलिं कृत्वा पर्यगच्छन्मनस्विनी॥
en: On coming to the banian, Vaidehī saluted it saying, “O mighty tree, I bow to you. May my husband fulfil his vow; and may we behold Kausalyā and the illustrious Sumitrā.” Having thus prayed with joined hands, the intelligent Sītā went away.

sa: स तु संज्ञामुपागम्य मुहूर्तान्मतिमान् नृपः। मनास्थामपि वैदेहीं चिन्तयामास राघवः॥
en: And regaining his sense after sometime, the highly intelligent king-Räghava began to think of Vaidehĩ although always present in his mind.

sa: मनोरथो महानेष भगीरथ महारथ। एवं भवतु भद्रं ते इक्ष्वाकुकुलवर्धन॥
en: O mighty car-warrior Bhagiratha, high is this your aim. Be it so, good betide you, you enhancer of the Ikşvāku line.

sa: अनेकशतसाहस्री विषण्णां हरिवाहिनीम्। जाम्बवान् समुदीक्ष्यैवं हनूमन्तमथाब्रवीत्॥
en: Surveying the monkey-host consisting of many hundred and thousand,-crest-fallen, Jämbavān thus spoke to Hanumān,

sa: आगताः स्माश्रमपदं सौमित्रे प्रविशाग्रतः। निवेदयेह मां. प्राप्तमृषये सह सीतया॥
en: Sumitra's son, entering the asylum before us, do you announce to the saints that I along with Sītā, have arrived here.

sa: स हि सोमगिरि म देवानामपि दुर्गमः। तमालोक्य ततः क्षिप्रमुपावर्तितुमर्हथ॥
en: And that mountain is named Soma, incapable of being entered even by the gods, Sighting this you should speedily turn back.

sa: हा हतोऽस्मि नृशंसोऽस्मि यत् सभार्यः कृते मम । ईदशी राघवः शय्यामधिशेते ह्यनाथवत्॥
en: Ah, I am undone! baleful am I, for it is on my account that Rāghava along with his wife, lay down in such a bed, like one forlorn.

sa: अनुज्ञास्तु भवता पूर्वमेव यदस्म्यहम्। किमिदानी पुनरपि क्रियते मे निवारणम्॥
en: Formerly you did order me to follow you; and why do you prevent me now from accompanying you to the forest.

sa: स विद्धः क्षतजादिग्धः सर्वगात्रेषु राघवः॥ बभूव रामः संध्याभैर्दिवाकर इवावृतः।
en: And pierced, and with his person covered with blood, Rāma, the descendant of Raghu, resembled the sun enveloped in evening clouds.

sa: तप्यमानं तमाज्ञाय वयस्याः प्रियवादिनः। आयासं विनयिष्यन्तः सभायां चक्रिरे कथाः॥
en: And finding him aggrieved, his sweet. speeched associates, endeavouring to chase the heaviness, began to converse on a variety of subjects.

sa: एतच्चैवोभयं श्रुत्वा सम्यक् सम्पश्य राघव। उत्तिष्ठ त्वं महाबाहो मां च स्पृश तथोदकम्॥
en: And, O scion of the Raghu race, hearing their utterances as regards both yourself and me, do you decide. Arise, you mighty-armed one. Touch me and then water.

sa: त्वया त्विदानी धर्मज्ञ राजत्वमवलम्ब्यताम्। त्वत्कृते हि मया सर्वमिदमेवंविधं कृतम्॥
en: Do you now, O you cognizant of duty, take charge of the kingdom. I have done all this in your interests.

sa: स्थितस्तु प्राङ्मुखो भूत्वा शुचिर्मुनिवरस्तदा । ददौ रामाय सुप्रीतो मन्त्रग्राममनुत्तमम्॥
en: Then with his face turned towards the east, that foremost of ascetics having purified himself, gladly conferred the mantras upon Rāma.

sa: यदि ते मत्प्रियं कार्यं यदि चावैषि मां हि ताम्। याच्यमानः प्रियत्वेन साधु वाक्यं कुरुष्व मे॥
en: If you does wish to go by my desire, if you does regard me as your well-wisher, do you perform what I do request you for your welfare. Be pleased and hear my beneficial words.

sa: रामे हि यौवराज्यस्थे राजा दशरथो वनम्। प्रवेक्ष्यति महेष्वासः पूर्ववृत्तमनुस्मरन्॥
en: On Rāma being installed as the heir-apparent, that best of bowmen, king Dasaratha, will depart for the forest, remembering ancient examples.

sa: सा तमुवीक्ष्य सुश्रोणी रावणस्य वशंगता। समाक्रन्दद् भयपरा दु:खोपहतया गिरा॥
en: Thereat the daughter of Janaka, brought under the control of Rāvana and terrified, began to cry and utter those piteous words.

sa: अग्निकल्पो हि भगवान् शापं दास्यति रोषतः॥ तस्मात् प्रवर्त्यतां यज्ञः सशरीरो यथा दिवि। गच्छेदिक्ष्वाकुदायादो विश्वामित्रस्य तेजसा॥
en: The worshipful one is like to fire, and, if angered, may curse us. Therefore, let us engage in this sacrifice, so that Ikşvāku's descendant through the potency of Viśvāmitra way repair to heaven in person.

sa: कुलस्य त्वमभावाय कालरात्रिरिवागता। अङ्गारमुपगूह्य स्म पिता मे नावबुद्धवान् ॥
en: You have come like the fatal night for the destruction of this race. Not under-standing it, my father embraced live coal.

sa: भाषमाणं महात्मानं राजपुत्र्यौ प्रसाद्य तम्। ऊचतुः परमप्रीते कृताञ्जलिपुटे तदा॥
en: As that best of men was saying this, those daughters of kings, exceedingly delighted, propitiating him, addressed him with clasped hands.

sa: गोलाङ्गुलमहाराजो गवाक्षो भीमविक्रमः। वृतः कोटिसहस्रेण वानराणामदृश्यत॥
en: And Gavaksa-sovereign of Golangulas-endowed with dreadful might, appeared, surrounded by thousand koțis of monkeys.

sa: तूष्णीभूते दशरथे वसिष्ठो भगवानृपिः॥ उवाच वाक्यं वाक्यज्ञो वैदेहं सपुरोधसम्।
en: And on Dasaratha resuming silence, the worshipful saint Vasistha, versed in speech, spoke to Vaideha in company with his priests, saying,

sa: कच्चित् स्त्रियः सान्त्वयसे कच्चित् तास्ते सुरक्षिताः। कच्चिन्न श्रद्दधास्यासां कच्चिद् गुह्यं न भाषसे॥
en: And do you conciliate the females; and are they well protected by you? And do you not regard them; and do you not open to them your mind?

sa: नानाहिताग्नि यज्वा न क्षुद्रो वा न तस्करः। कश्चिदासीदयोध्यायां न चावृत्तो न संकरः॥
en: There were not on Ayodhyā persons not lighting the sacrificial fire, or not performing sacrifices, or mean-minded, or thieving, or engaged in improper occupations, or of impure descent.

sa: ततः सूतो यथापूर्वं पार्थिवस्य निवेशने। सुमन्त्रः प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा तुष्टाव जगतीपतिम्॥
en: And having entered the apartment of the king, the charioteer Sumantra with clasped hands, pleasing the monarch as he proceeded, said.

sa: त्वं पौरजनवद् व्यालानयोध्यामिव पर्वतम्। मन्यस्व वनिते नित्यं सरयूवदिमां नदीम्॥
en: Do you, my wife, always consider the wild animals as citizens, the mountain as Ayodhyā, and this stream as the Sarayū.

sa: लालितश्चाङ्गदो वीरः सुकुमारः सुखोचितः। वत्स्यते कामवस्था मे पितृव्ये क्रोधमूर्छिते॥
en: How shall the heroic and youthful Angada, brought up in luxury and happiness, be regarded by his uncle, senseless with wrath?

sa: तं रथं सूर्यसंकाशं सीता हृष्टेन चेतसा। आरुरोह वरारोहा कृत्वालंकारमात्मनः॥
en: Then having adorned her person, that best of her sex, Sītā, with a glad heart ascended the car resembling the sun.

sa: ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः। अब्रुवन् सूर्यसंकाशां सुरसां नागमातरम्॥
en: Thereupon the celestial along with Gandharvas, Siddhas and the ascetics, spake to Surasā the mother of serpents, resembling the Sun, saying.

sa: वसिष्ठं स समाहूय कथयामास चिन्तितम्॥ अशक्यमिति चाप्युक्तो वसिष्ठेन महात्मना।
en: And summoning Vasiştha, he unfolded his mind to him. And on the high-souled Vasiştha saying, 'I am incapable of doing this,'

sa: स एष राघवभ्राता लक्ष्मणो वाक्यसारथिः। व्यवसायरथः प्राप्तस्तस्य रामस्य शासनात्॥
en: That Laksmana, Raghava's brother, having words for his charioteer, and perseverance for his chariot, has approached you at his brother's command.

sa: शुश्रूषां गौरवं चैव प्रमाणं वचनक्रियाम्। कस्तु भूयस्तरं कुर्यादन्यत्र पुरुषर्षभात्॥
en: Who will, save that foremost of men, so devotedly minister to you, regard you, enhance your influence, and do your will.

sa: अपि त्वामीश्वरं प्राप्य कामवृत्तं निरङ्कशम्। नि विनश्येत् पुरी लङ्का त्वया सह सराक्षसा॥
en: And if having obtained for her lord you that are wilful and wicked, the city of Lankā with you and the Rākṣasas do not meet with utter extermination.

sa: ततस्तदिक्ष्वाकुवरौ सततं विविधैर्दुमैः। काननं तौ विविशतुः सीतया सह राघवौ॥
en: Then those worthy scions of the Ikşvāku race-descendants of Raghu—with Sītā entered the forest ever furnished with various kinds of trees.

sa: एवं बहुविधं दीनं याचमानं पुनः पुनः। रामो भृत्यानुकम्पी तु सुमन्त्रमिदमब्रवीत्॥ जानामि परमां भक्तिमहं ते भर्तृवत्सल। शृणु चापि यदर्थं त्वां प्रेषयामि पुरीमितः॥
en: Thereupon Rāma kind towards servants, said these words to Sumantra as he besought him thus humbly in various ways, O you that bear attachment to your master, I know that you regard me highly. But do you listen as to why I send you to the city from hence.

sa: ताभ्यां सह महाराजः पत्नीभ्यां तप्तवांस्तपः। हिमवन्तं समासाद्य भृगुप्रस्रवणे गिरौ॥
en: And with those wives of his, that mighty king, coming to the Himavat, began to practice austerities on the mountain Bhrguprasravaņa.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा महातेजा जगाम सह दैवतैः॥ त्रिविष्टपं ब्रह्मलोकं लोकानां परमेश्वरः।
en: Having said this, the highly energetic prime Lord of all creatures went to the celestial regions in company with the celestials.

sa: निर्वृत्ते तु क्रतौ तस्मिन् हयमेधे महात्मनः। प्रतिगृह्यामरा भागान् प्रतिजग्मुर्यथागतम्॥
en: When the horse-sacrifice of the high-souled Dasaratha had been completed, the immortals, accepting each his share, returned whence they had come.

sa: एवमुक्तो वसिष्ठेन राघवः प्राङ्मुखः स्थितः। पादुके हेमविकृते मम राज्याय ते ददौ ॥
en: Thus addressed by Vasiştha, Rāghava facing the east, conferred on me his sandals decked in gold, in order that I mighty carry on the government of the kingdom.

sa: अम्बरीषस्य पुत्रोऽभूनहुषश्च महीपतिः। नहुषस्य ययातिस्तु नाभागस्तु ययातिजः॥ नाभागस्य बभूवाज अजाद् दशरथोऽभवत्। अस्माद् दशरथाज्जातौ भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ॥
en: Ambarisa's son was Nahusa, lord of earth. And Nahusa's son was Yayāti, was Nābhāga. And Nābhāga's son was Aja, and from Aja sprung Dasaratha. And from this Dasaratha have come the brothers Rāma and Lakşmaņa.

sa: या चेयं जगतो माता सर्वलोकनमस्कृता। अस्याश्च चलनं भूमेर्दृश्यते कोशलेश्वर॥
en: O lord of Kosala, even Vasumati, the mother of the world, adored of all beings, meet with misery consequent upon earth-quake.

sa: स्मर राजन् पुरा वृत्तं तस्मिन् देवासुरे रणे। तत्र त्वां च्यावयच्छत्रुस्तव जीवितमन्तरा ॥
en: Remember, o king, the incidents that took place formerly in the war between gods and Asuras. Incapable of taking your life, your enemy had rendered you exceedingly feeble.

sa: एवमस्मात् स्वकां नारी सुवृत्तां हि पतिव्रताम्। नाभिरोचयसे नेतुं त्वं मां केनेह हेतुना॥
en: For what reason then did you not wish to take your wife with you who is of good character and devoted to her husband? Do you take me.

sa: सम्पन्नां श्रियमन्विच्छंस्तस्य राज्ञः सुदुर्लभाम्। भरतः कैकयीपुत्रो हन्तुं समधिगच्छति ॥
en: Desirous of taking complete possession of the rare regal fortune of that sovereign (Rāma), Kaikeyi's son, Bharata, comes to destroy him.

sa: प्रियाविहीने दुःखाते हृतराज्ये विवासिते। कृपां न कुरुते राजा सुग्रीवो मयि लक्ष्मण ॥
en: O Laksmana, Sugriva, is not inclined to show any commiseration towards me, who am separated from my beloved spouse, deprived of my kingdom, banished and stricken with sorrow.

sa: महाब्रह्मर्षिसृष्टा वा ज्वलन्तो भीमदर्शनाः। धिग्वाग्दण्डा न हिंसन्ति रामप्रव्राजने स्थिताम्॥
en: Why does not the flaming and dreadful censure uttered by the mighty Brahmarşis destroy you who are bent upon banishing Rāma?

sa: आनाय्य च महाबाहुं कोसलेन्द्रं महाबलम्। स्वयमेव प्रवेक्ष्यामि वनं मुनिनिषेचितम्॥
en: Bringing hither the mighty-armed lord of Kosala endowed with immense strength, I myself will repair to the forest inhabited by ascetics.

sa: एवं बहुविधं तं सा याचते गमनं प्रति। नानुमेने महाबाहुस्तां नेतुं विजनं वनम्॥
en: She begged Rāma in these and various other means to take her with him, but that mighty hero did not consent to lead her into the lonely forest.

sa: ततः समुपजिघ्रन्ती कपिराजस्य तन्मुखम्। पतिं लोकश्रुता तारा मृतं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Thereupon smelling the face of that lord of monkeys, Tārā again addressed her deceased lord, known all over the world, saying.

sa: श्रूयते हि पुरा शक्रो विरोचनसुतां नृप। पृथिवीं हन्तुमिच्छन्ती मन्थरामभ्यसूदयत्॥
en: We hear, O king, that in days of yore, ſakra slew Virocana's daughter, Mantharā, who had intended to destroy the earth.

sa: ते हयैर्गोरथैः शीघ्रं स्यन्दनैश्च मनोजवैः। सह योषिद्बलाघ्यक्षा बलं सर्वमचोदयन्॥
en: And the generals expeditiously despatched their forces with warriors by means of horses and cares and cars fleet as the mind.

sa: प्रविशन्नभ्रजालीनि निष्पतंश्च पुनः पुनः। प्रच्छन्नश्च प्रकाशश्च चन्द्रमा इव दृश्यते॥
en: And now entering into the clouds, and now emerging from them, he looked like the moon, sometimes hid and sometimes visible.

sa: युध्यस्व यदि शूरोऽसि मुहूर्तं तिष्ठ रावण। शयिष्यसे हतो भूमौ यथा भ्राता खरस्तथा॥
en: Do you fight. O Ravana, if you are a hero, or wait for a moment and you shall lie down on the earth like to your brother Khara.

sa: तृषार्तं सति पानीये विप्रलम्भेन योजयन्। यत् पापं लभते तत् स्याद् यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः॥
en: May he that had approved of the exile into the woods of the noble one bear the sin that is his that serves a thirsty soul with deceit.

sa: दयिता त्वं सदा भर्तुरत्र मे नास्ति संशयः। त्वत्कृते च महाराजो विशेदपि हुताशनम्॥
en: You have always been the favourite wife of your husband. Of this I have not the least doubt, For your sake the monarch can enter into a flame.

sa: तां श्रुत्वा करुणां वाचं पितुर्मरणसंहिताम्। राघवो भरतेनोक्तां बभूव गतचेतनः॥
en: Hearing those piteous words uttered by Bharata in connection with the demise of their father, Rāghava was deprived of his senses.

sa: कदा ह्यहं समेष्यामि भरतेन महात्मना। शत्रुघ्नेन च वीरेण त्वया च रघुनन्दन ॥
en: When shall I; O son of Raghu, meet with the high-souled Bharata, and the heroic Satrughna, and yourself*. *The meaning is evident when shall we all meet together.-T

sa: किं नु खल्वद्य गम्भीरो मूर्च्छितो न निशाम्यते। यथापुरमयोध्यायां गीतवादित्रनिःस्वनः॥
en: Why do I not hear as formerly the solemn sounds of song and instrumental music spreading on all sides in Ayodhyā?

sa: प्रतिबुद्धो मुहूर्तेन शोकोपहतचेतनः। अथ राजा दशरथः स चिन्तामभ्यपद्यत ॥
en: Starting in a moment from sleep, king Dasaratha deprived (almost) of his consciousness by grief, (again) became a prey to thought.

sa: सुकुमारं महासत्त्वं पार्थिवव्यञ्जनान्वितम्। राममिन्दीवरश्यामं कंदर्पसदृशप्रभम्॥ वभूवेन्द्रोपमं दृष्ट्वा राक्षसी काममोहिता।
en: And beholding Rāma dark-blue like the lotus, and becoming like Kandarpa himself, and resembling Indra, the Rākşasi was maddened with desire.

sa: प्रागुदक्प्रवणे देशे गुहा साधु भविष्यति। पश्चाच्चैवोन्नता सौम्य निवातेयं भविष्यति॥
en: This cave shall be worthy of our habitation, O gentle one, having its north-eastern part low and the western part high.

sa: चतुर्दश हि वर्षाणि रामे प्रवाजिते वनम्। रूढश्च कृतमूलश्च शेषं स्थास्यति ते सुतः॥
en: And Rāma having been banished for fourteen years, your son growing (in the interval) firm and fast, will remain (on the throne) during the rest of his life.

sa: अनाथश्च हि वृद्धश्च मया चैव विना कृतः। किं करिष्यति कामात्मा कैकेय्या वशमागतः।।।।।
en: Forlorn and old and deprived of me. I do not know what he will do, his soul possessed by desire, and having come under the influence of Kaikeyi.

sa: सा विद्वज्जनसम्पूर्णा सभा सुरुचिरा तथा। अदृश्यत घनापाये पूर्णचन्द्रेव शर्वरी॥
en: And that splendid assembly filled with learned people looked like he night of the full moon after the clouds have dispersed.

sa: उपलभ्य शनैः संज्ञां तं मे शंसितुमर्हसि। येन त्वं दुर्विनीतेन वने विक्रम्य निर्जिता॥
en: Recovering by degrees your sense, it behoves you to tell me what individual it was of execrable character, who by his prowess, half humbled you in the forest.

sa: सास्मि भीता समुद्विग्ना विषण्णा च निशाचर। शरणं त्वं पुनः प्राप्ता सर्वतो भयदर्शिनी॥ विषादनक्राध्युषिते परित्रासोर्मिमालिनि। किं मां न त्रायसे मग्नां विपुले शोकसागरे॥
en: O ranger of the night, I am afraid, and agitated, and cast down. I have (at length) found in you a refuge, seeing fear on all sides. Will you not rescue me who am sinking in this ocean of grief, having sorrow for its alligators and affright for billows?

sa: त्वां तु काञ्चनवर्णाभां दृष्ट्वा कौशेयवासिनाम्। रति स्वकेषु दारेषु नाधिगच्छाम्यनिन्दिते॥
en: O you of blameless beauty, seeing you of golden hue and wearing silk cloth I do not relish my own wives.

sa: ततस्तु निनदं गोरं कृत्वा युद्धाय चाह्वयत्। परिवारैः परिवृत्तो नादर्भिन्दनिवाम्बरम्॥
en: Setting up a terrible uproar and rending the sky with his cry (Sugrīva) encircled by his kinsmen, invited (Vāli) to battle.

sa: दानयज्ञविवाहेषु समाजेषु महत्सु च। न द्रक्ष्यामः पुनर्जातु धार्मिकं राममन्तरा॥
en: We shall no longer see the righteous Rāma in the midst of mighty assemblies engaged in charity, sacrifice or nuptial rites.

sa: कच्चिदग्निषु ते युक्तो विधिज्ञो मतिमानृजुः। हुतं च होष्यमाणं च काले वेदयते सदा॥
en: Do intelligent and sincere people cognizant of the rules, look after the sacrificial fire? And do they regularly inform you of the proper seasons for performing the fire-sacrifice?

sa: तान् सर्वान् पीडितान् दृष्ट्वा सुरान् सुरपतिस्तदा। गमनायोपचक्राम दिशं वरुणपालिताम्॥
en: Witnessing the gods, thus distressed, the lord of the celestials set out in the direction presided over by Varuna (The West).

sa: इत्युक्त्वा वचनं रामश्चापं संधाय वेगवान्॥ मानवं परमोदारमस्त्रं परमभास्वरम्। वक्षेप परमवुद्धो मारीचोरसि राघवः॥
en: Saying this, that descendant of Raghu, Rāma, in vehemence fixing on his bow an exceedingly mighty and gloriously-dazzling Mānava weapon, discharged it in great wrath at Mārīca's chest.

sa: प्रकृत्या शीतलस्पर्शो हिमविद्धश्च साम्प्रतम्। प्रवाति पश्चिमो वायुः काले द्विगुणशीतलः॥
en: And at this season the western wind naturally of gelid feel, being permeated at present with cold, Flows with ouble coldness.

sa: गते तस्मिन् नरश्रेष्ठ दितिः परमहर्षिता। कुशप्लवं समासाद्य तपस्तेपे सुदारुणम्॥
en: When he had gone, Diti, O foremost of men, becoming exceedingly delighted, went to, Kuśaplava and began to practise rigid mortifications.

sa: नरेन्द्रेणैवमुक्तस्तु गत्वा कोशगृहं ततः। प्रायच्छत् सर्वमाहृत्य सीतायै क्षिप्रमेव तत्॥
en: Thus desired by the foremost of men, that officer repairing to the treasury, procuring all those, speedily presented them to Sītā.

sa: भागीरथी दुष्प्रतरां सोंऽशुधाने महानदीम्। उपायात् राघवस्तूर्णं प्राग्वटे विश्रुते पुरे॥
en: Seeing that the mighty river Gangā was hard to cross at Ansudhāna, Bharata speedily went to the famous city of Prāgvața.

sa: मया चैतद्वचः श्रुत्वा कात्स्न्येन परिपालनम्॥ ऋषीणां दण्डकारण्ये संश्रुतं जनकात्मजे।
en: Having heard these words, I promised my perfect protection to the saints in the forest of Dandaka, O daughter of Janaka.

sa: अथ पश्यामि दूरस्थमृषि ज्वलिततेजसम्। कृताभिषेकं दुर्धर्षमुपावृत्तमुदङ्मुखम्॥
en: Then at a distance I saw the saint, flaming in energy and irrepressible,-returning northwards.

sa: आमन्त्रयन् समागम्य सर्वे सर्षिगणाः सुराः॥ महर्षिशब्दं लभतां साध्वयं कुशिकात्मजः।
en: Then taking counsel together, the celestials and the saints appeared before (Brahma), saying, 'Let Kusika's son obtain the title of Maharsi.'

sa: वृक्षाद् वृक्षं प्रधावन् स गिरिश्चापि नदीनदम्। बभ्राम विलपरामः शोकपङ्कार्णवप्लुतः॥
en: He rushed from tree to tree, and bewailing being sunk in an ocean of grief traversed all the rivers and mountains.

sa: अथोत्तरमुदारार्थमब्रवीदङ्गदस्तदा। अनुमान्य तदा प्राज्ञो जाम्बवन्तं महाकपिः॥
en: After this, saluting the mighty monkey, Jāmbavān, the wise Angada spoke straight sense, saying,

sa: नाराजके जनपदे वाहनैः शीघ्रवाहिभिः। नरा निर्यान्त्यरण्यानि नारीभिः सह कामिनः॥
en: In a kingless country pleasure-seeking people do not in company with females go to the woods by means of swift vehicles.

sa: उपस्थितः प्रयुञ्जानस्त्वयि सान्त्वमनर्थकम्। अर्थे वाद्य ते भर्ता कौसल्यां योजयिष्यति॥
en: Speaking to you soft words bare of substance, he will, his heart on the alert, to-day compass the welfare of Kausalyä.

sa: भृशमसुखममर्षिता तदा बहु विललाप समीक्ष्य राघवम्। व्यसनमुपनिशाम्य सा महत् सुतमिव बद्धमवेक्ष्य किंनरी॥
en: Kausalyā like a Kinnarī unable to bear this great calamity, anticipating great misfortune and seeing Rāma bound (with a great vow), began to lament in various ways. some

sa: तत् त्वया पुत्रगर्धिन्या पुत्रस्य कृतमप्रियम्। लोके नहि स विद्येत यो न राममनुव्रतः॥
en: Therefore although intent on advancing your son, you have really brought about his injury. There exists not a person in the world that is not partial to Rāma.

sa: गात्रेषु वलयः प्राप्ताः श्वेताश्चैव शिरोरुहाः। जरया पुरुषो जीर्णः किं हि कृत्वा प्रभावयेत्॥
en: The person is filled with folds in the skin, the hair has grown hoary, the individual is enfeebled because of age, by doing what, can be prevent this?

sa: तथा तु तारा करुणं रुदन्ती भर्तुः समीपे सह वानरीभिः। व्यवस्यत प्रायमनिन्द्यवर्णा उपोपवेष्टं भुवि यत्र वाली॥
en: O hero, I touch your feet with my head. Bewailing thus piteously with other sbemonkeys, Tārā, having a blameless countenance, stationing herself where Vāli was, resolved to put an end to her being by fastings.

sa: दीयतां दीयतामन्नं वासांसि विविधानि च। इति संचोदितास्तत्र तथा चक्रनेकशः॥
en: And Give food, and clothes of various kinds (was heard all around) And those employed in the task gave away profusely.

sa: इत्येवमुक्त्वा भरतः सूतं तं दीनमानसः। तान्यनिष्टान्ययोध्यायां प्रेक्ष्य राजगृहं ययौ॥
en: Having said this to the charioteer, Bharata, beholding these inauspicious sights, entered the palace of the king with a depressed heart.

sa: अद्य गच्छामहे राम सिद्धाश्रममनुत्तमम्। तदाश्रमपदं तात तवाप्येतद् यथा मम॥
en: To-day, O Rama, will I repair to this supremely excellent Siddhāśrama. And this asylum, child, is as much your as mine.

sa: जीवेत माता परिपालनार्थम्। विना तु पुत्रं परितापदीना सा नैव जीवेदिति निश्चितं मे॥
en: The heroic Angada shall not live to-day and if he lives, his another shall live to bring him up. Forsooth, without her son, she shall not live long.

sa: स हि देशो दुरन्वेष्यो गुहागहनवान् महान्। तत्र वायुसुतः सर्वं विचिनोति स्म पर्वतम्॥
en: And that spacious country, consisting as it did, of caves and grots and woods, was difficult to search. And there the wind-god's offspring searched all over the mountain.

sa: शकृन्मूत्रं च मुञ्चानां भयविभ्रान्तमानसाः। व्यादितास्या महारौद्रा व्यनदन् भीषणान् रवान्॥
en: As they were bewildered with fear, these fearful animals discharge urine and dung and set up loud yells with gaping mouths.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच ततोऽश्मवर्षं सुमहत् प्रादुरासीत् समन्ततः। नगमात्रैः शिलाखण्डैस्तन्मां दृढमपीडयत्॥
en: Arjuna said: Then commenced a mighty shower of stones from all sides; (and) those stones, big as rocks, sore oppressed me.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तथेति सम्प्रतिज्ञाय लोमशः सुमहातपाः। काम्यकं वनमुद्दिश्य समुपायान्महीतलम्॥
en: The greatly ascetic Lomasha, saying, “Be it So," went to the earth with the intention of going to the Kamyaka forest.

sa: व्यपयातेषु दैत्येषु प्रादुर्भूते च दर्शने। अपश्यं दानवांस्तत्र हतान् शतसहस्रशः॥
en: The Daityas having fled and everything being disclosed to view, I beheld there hundreds and thousands of the Danavas (lying) slain.

sa: संस्तूयमानो गन्धर्वैर्ऋषिभिश्च तपोधनैः। शृङ्गं गिरेः समासाद्य तस्थौ सूर्य इवोदितः॥
en: Eulogised by Gandharvas and greatly ascetic Rishis, he, attaining to a summit of a mountain, stood there like the rising sun.

sa: तदवैक्षत पाञ्चाली दिव्यगन्धं मनोरमम्। अनिलेनाहृतं भूमौ पतितं जलजं शुचि॥
en: The Panchala princess saw that pure and charming lotus of celestials fragrance lying on the ground being brought by the wind.

sa: संजय उवाच तवेदं स्वकृतं राजन् महद् वैरमुपस्थितम्। विनाशो येन लोकस्य सानुबन्धो भविष्यति॥
en: Sanjaya said O king, this is assuredly a great act of yours, this great hostility which is inevitable and which will cause the destruction of the whole world.

sa: पतिव्रताया माहात्म्यं ब्राह्मणस्य च सत्तम। मातापित्रोश्च शुश्रूषा धर्मव्याधेन कीर्तिता॥
en: The virtue of women's devotion to their husbands and the filial piety as described to the Brahmana by the virtuous fowler.

sa: त्वमग्निः प्रथमं सृष्टो ब्रह्मणा तिमिरापहः। स्वस्थानं प्रतिपद्यस्व शीघ्रमेव तमोनुद॥
en: You Agni was first created by Brahma to dispel darkness. O destroyer of darkness, do you quickly occupy your own place."

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच बृहस्पतेश्चान्द्रमसी भार्याऽऽसीद् या यशस्विनी। अग्नीन् साजनयत् पुण्यान् षडेकां चापि पुत्रिकाम्॥
en: Markandeya said : Brihaspati had a celebrated wife belonging to the lunar world. He begot on her six sons, all of them by different fires and one daughter.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच राजाधिराज तव समीपं सेदुकेन प्रेषितो भिक्षितुमागतः। तेनानुशिष्टेन मया त्वं भिक्षितोऽसि॥
en: Brahmana said : O king of kings, sent to you by Seduka I came to you to beg. For your bad conduct, I am going to curse you.

sa: दृष्ट्वा कृतं नि:सलिलं महार्णवं सुराः समस्ताः परमप्रहृष्टाः। प्रगृह्य दिव्यानि वरायुधानि तान् दानवाञ्जनुरदीनसत्त्वाः॥
en: Seeing the great ocean made waterless, all the celestials were filled with joy; and taking up various celestials weapons they began to kill the Danayas with courageous hearts.

sa: तस्माच्छत्रुवधे राजन् क्रियतां निश्चयस्त्वया। क्षत्रियस्य हि सर्वस्य नान्योधर्मोऽस्ति संयुगात्॥
en: O king, therefore make up your mind to kill your enemies. There is no virtue higher to a Kshatriya than battle.

sa: देशं विरजसं पश्य मेरोः शिखरमुत्तमम्। यत्रात्मतृप्तरध्यास्ते देवैः सह पितामहः॥
en: Behold that excellent summit of the Meru that bright region when the grandsire (Brahma) sits with the gods, happy in self-knowledge.

sa: दमयन्ती तु तच्छ्रुत्वा नलस्य परिदेवितम्। प्राञ्जलिर्वेपमाना च भीता वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Hearing these weeping of Nala, Damayanti became greatly terrified; and she, trembling with fear and with folded hands, spoke these words.

sa: तत्र स्नात्वा नरव्याघ्र न शोचति नराधिप।
en: O foremost of men, O king, bathing there, one becomes freed from fall sorrow.

sa: यस्मिन् ब्रह्मसदश्चैव भूतात्मा चावतिष्ठते। प्रजापतिः सृजन् सर्वं यत् किञ्चिज्जङ्गमागमम्॥
en: There the court of Brahma is (held) and remaining where the universal soul Prajapati created all that is mobile and immobile.

sa: ततः कश्चिन्मृगव्याधो विचरन् गहने वने। आक्रन्दमानां संश्रुत्य जवेनाभिससार ह॥
en: Then a hunter who was roaming in the deep forest, hearing the sound of her loud wailing's speedily came near her.

sa: अपि शाकं पचानस्य सुखं वै मघवन् गृहे। अर्जितं स्वेन वीर्येण नाप्यपाश्रित्य कञ्चन॥ फलशाकमपि श्रेयो भोक्तुं शकृपणं गृहे। परस्य तु गृहे भोक्तुः परिभूतस्य नित्यशः॥ सुमृष्टमपि न श्रेयो विकल्पोऽयमतः सताम्। श्ववत् कोलालपो यस्तु परान्नं भोक्तुमिच्छति॥ धिगस्तु तस्य तद् भुक्तं कृपणस्य दुरात्मनः। यो दत्त्वातिथिभूतेभ्यः पितृभ्यश्च द्विजोत्तमः॥
en: O Maghavan, even he is happy who cooks only little leaves (for his food). Earned by his own efforts, he who eats even fruits and leaves in his own house deserves to be respected. He, who eats in another's house the food given to him in contempt, even if that food be rich and palatable, does a thing which is hateful. Therefore the wise cry "fie" on the food that a mean wretch like a dog or a Rakshasa eats at another's house. If after feeding the guests and the servants and offering food to the Pitris, an excellent Brahmana.

sa: ततो मुहूर्तं संगृह्य स्यन्दनप्रवरं हरिः। अब्रवीत् पुण्डरीकाक्षः कुन्तीपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: Then the lotus-eyed Hari (Krishna) stopped for a moment that excellent chariot; and thus spoke to the son of Kunti, Yudhishthira.

sa: यां न वायुर्न चादित्यः पुरा पश्यति मे प्रियाम्। सेयमद्य सभामध्ये शेते भूमावनाथवत्॥
en: ‘My dear-loved wife, whom even the winds or the sun could not sce before, is even now lying asleep like one helpless on the ground of this inn.

sa: गतेन तेनास्मि कृतो विचेता गात्रं च मे सम्परिदह्यतीव। इच्छामि तस्यान्तिकमाशु गन्तुं तं चेह नित्यं परिवर्तमानम्॥
en: At his departure my heart has become sad and my body seems to be burning. I desire to go to him as soon as I can. I desire that he should always walk about here.

sa: तानुवाच महाभागः सर्वलोकपितामहः। गच्छध्वं त्रिदशा: सर्वे लोकैः सार्धं यथागतम्॥
en: To them said the greatly cxalted Grandsire of all creatures, “O celestials, go back whence you came with all these creatures.

sa: एवमस्त्विति सा तेन पाण्डव प्रतिनन्दिता। जमदग्निं ततः पुत्रं जज्ञे सा काल आगते॥
en: O son of Pandu, he replied, “Be it so;" and he was pleased to grant her prayer. When the proper time came, her son was born, named Jamadagani.

sa: भूमौ निपतितो ब्रह्मन्नुवाच प्रतिनादयन्। नापराध्याम्यहं किंचित् केन पापमिदं कृतम्॥
en: The Brahmana fell down on the ground and screaming aloud said "I have done no wrong, what wretch has done this?

sa: भूमिर्नद्यो नगाः शैलाः सिद्धा देवा महर्षयः। कालं समनुवर्तन्ते यथा भावा युगे युगे।॥
en: The ground, the rivers, the plants, the rocks, the Siddhas, the celestials, the great Rishis, all conform to Time, as it comes to be in the different Yugas.

sa: ते तदस्त्रं विधूयाशु विव्यधू रुधिराशनाः। शिरस्युरसि वक्त्रे च स मुमोह पपात च॥
en: These (weapons), which ever delight (in tasting) blood, warded off the arrows of the Daitya and pierced his head, bosom and face. Thereupon he (Shalva) fell down senseless.

sa: ऋते त्वां मानुषी मर्यं न पश्यामि महावने। तथा नो यक्षराडद्य मणिभद्रः प्रसीदतु॥
en: Save and except yourself I do not find any mortal in this terrible forest. So, may Manibhadra, the king of the Yakshas, be propitious on us this day!

sa: अनन्तरं च राधेयः शकुनिश्च विशाम्पते। आहतुः पार्थिवश्रेष्ठं धृतराष्ट्र जनाधिपम्॥
en: O king, the son of Radha (Karna) and Shakuni thus spoke to that foremost of kings, the ruler of earth, Dhritarashtra,

sa: याश्च क्रूरेषु सत्त्वेषु वर्तमाना जुगुप्सिताः। स्वकर्म कुर्वन्ति सदा दुष्करं तच्च मे मतम्॥
en: That the persons, who are desirous of doing evils to others and who are always engaged in cruel deeds, discharge their duties, is, in my opinion, highly difficult.

sa: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु सखा दशरथस्य लोमपाद इति ख्यातो ह्यङ्गानामीश्वरोऽभवत्॥
en: At this time there was a king of Anga, known by the name of Lomapada, who was the friend of Dasharatha.

sa: एकपल्यश्च या नार्यो याश्च सत्यं वदन्त्युत। कुक्षिणा दश मासांश्च गर्भं संधारयन्ति याः॥
en: To those women who are attached to one lord; and those who speak the truth; and those who conceive in their womb a child for full ten months;

sa: न तत्र विषयस्त्वासीन्मम सैन्यस्य भारत। खे विषक्तं हि तत् सौभं क्रोशमात्र इवाभवत्॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, as that (car) Saubha made of precious metals was in the sky full two miles off, it could not be seen by my troops.

sa: यथा च वो न जानीयाद् ब्रुवतो मम शासनात्। पुनरागमनं चैव तथा कार्यमतन्द्रितैः॥
en: Do you take care that no body should know that these words are uttered by you at my behest; neither do you do such to return to me.

sa: ततोऽर्जुनः शरवर्षं किराते समवासृजत्। तत् प्रसन्नेन मनसा प्रतिजग्राह शङ्करः॥
en: Arjuna poured a shower of arrows on the Kirata, but Shankara (Shiva) received them all upon him with a cheerful heart.

sa: उद्धृत्यालिञ्जरात् तस्मात् ततः स भगवान् मनुः। तं मत्स्यमनयद् वापी महतीं स मनुस्तदा॥
en: Then the exalted Manu, that conqueror of hostile cities, took it out of that vessel and carried it to a large tank and put it into its water).

sa: यच्च मां भगवानाह तीर्थानां दर्शनं प्रति। धौम्यस्य वचनादेषा बुद्धिः पूर्वं कृतव मे॥
en: What your exalted self has said to me as regards seeing the Tirthas I have already made up my mind to do it) at the words of Dhaumya.

sa: शकुनिरुवाच धर्मज्ञः पाण्डवो ज्येष्ठः प्रतिज्ञातं च संसदि। तेन द्वादश वर्षाणि वस्तव्यानीति भारत।॥
en: Shakuni said: O descendant of Bharata, the eldest Pandava is virtuous; he has taken the pledge in the assembly that he will live twelve years in the forest.

sa: कमण्डलूनुपादाय जातरूपमयाञ्छुभान्। एतद् धनं समादाय प्रवेशं लेभिरे न च॥
en: Even having brought with them Ghee in golden Kamandalus (sort of water pot), they could not get admission into the palace.

sa: मृगयां चैव नो गन्तुमिच्छा संवर्तते भृशम्। स्मारणं तु चिकीर्षामो न तु पाण्डवदर्शनम्॥
en: We desire very much to go to a hunting expedition; we shall also take that opportunity to count the cattle. We have no wish to see the Pandavas.

sa: क्षणेन क्षीणबाणोऽथ संवृत्तः फाल्गुनस्तदा। भीश्चैनमाविशत् तीव्रा तं दृष्ट्वा शरसंक्षयम्॥
en: The arrows of Falguni were soon exhausted; and seeing that all his arrows were exhausted, he was seized with great fear.

sa: व्याध उवाच मूर्धानमाश्रितो वह्निः शरीरं परिपालयन्। प्राणो मूर्धनि चाग्नौ च वर्तमानो विचेष्टते॥
en: The Fowler said: The vital spirit manifesting itself it seat the consciousness causes the action of the corporeal frame. The soul being present in both of these acts.

sa: यवक्रीत उवाच न चैतदेवं क्रियते देवराज ममेप्सितम्। महता नियमेनाहं तप्स्ये घोरतरं तपः॥
en: Yavakrit said : O king of the celestials, if you will not do what I desire, I shall, then, by observing stricter vows, practise still more severe austerities.

sa: चापलादिह गच्छन्तं पार्थ यानमितः परम्। अयः शूलादिभिर्जन्ति राक्षसाः शत्रुसूदन॥
en: O destroyer of foes, if any one impudently goes beyond this, the Rakshasas kill him with iron darts and other weapons,

sa: स मामभ्यनुजामीहि मातुलाद्य सुदुःखितम्। अमर्षं च समाविष्टं धृतराष्ट्र निवेदय॥
en: O uncle, know me now to be in great grief and full of jealousy, of jealousy, speak of it to Dhritarashtra.

sa: योऽपि स्यात् पीठगः कश्चित् किं पुनः समरे स्थितः स त्वं पुरुषशार्दूल सर्वयत्नौरिमं प्रभो॥ जहि वृष्णिकुलश्रेष्ठ मा त्वां कालोऽत्यगात् पुनः नैष मार्दवसाध्यो वै मतो नापि सखा तव॥ येन त्वं योधितो वीर द्वारका चावमर्दिता। एवमादि तु कौन्तेय श्रुत्वाहं सारथेर्वचः॥ तत्त्वमेतदिति ज्ञात्वा युद्धे मतिमधारयम्। वधाय शाल्वराजस्य सौभस्य च निपातने॥
en: Even if he is at his feet, not to speak of one who dares for stay in battle. O lord, put forth every exertion. And conquer him. O best of the Vrishni race, O hero, do not make any further delay. That one is not to be killed by milder means. In my opinion he can never be a friend who devastated Dvarka and who is now fighting with you." O son of Kunti, hearing such words of my charioteer. And knowing that what he had said was true, I again engaged myself in the fight with the intention of killing Shalva and destroying his Saubha (car).

sa: बहूनि च सहस्राणि प्रयुतान्यर्बुदान्यपि। रथेनानेन दैत्यानां जितवान् मघवा युधि॥
en: And riding on this car also Maghavana had conquered in battle several thousands and millions and hundreds of millions of Daityas.

sa: जलहीनं सरो दृष्ट्वा यवक्रीस्त्वरितः पुनः। जगाम सरितः सर्वास्ताश्चाप्यासन् विशोषिताः॥
en: Having seen that tank to be without water, Yavakrit went to all the rivers, but they too all were dried up.

sa: वृद्धावूचतुः कुशलं नौ गृहे विप्र भृत्यवर्गे च सर्वशः। कच्चित् त्वमप्यविघ्नेन सम्प्राप्तो भगवन्निति॥
en: The aged ones said : O Brahmana, we are all well in our home with all our servants. O exalted, one, have you come here without any difficulty?

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच किमर्थं राजशार्दुल: सगरः पुत्रमात्मजम्। त्यक्तवान् दुस्त्यजं वीरं तन्मे ब्रूहि तपोधन॥
en: Yudhishthira said : O great ascetic, tell me why that foremost of kings, Sagara abandoned his own heroic son, a son who was not fit to be abandoned?

sa: अकृतव्रण उवाच आयानेवासि विदितो रामस्य विदितात्मनः। प्रीतिस्त्वयि च रामस्य क्षिप्रं त्वां दर्शयिष्यति॥
en: Akritavrana said : Your coming here is already known to Rama whose soul spontaneously knows everything. Rama is pleased with you. He will soon show himself to you.

sa: फेनवत्यः प्रकीर्णाश्च संहताश्च समुत्थिताः। ऊर्मयश्चात्र दृश्यन्ते वल्गन्त इव पर्वताः॥
en: (And) on it were visible, foamy and swelling waves scattered all over, dashing against each other and looking like moving rocks.

sa: स तु देवान् सगन्धर्वान् जित्वा धुन्धुरमर्षणः। बबाध सर्वानसकृद् विष्णुं देवांश्च वै भृशम्॥
en: The unconquerable Dhundhu first defeated all the celestials as well as the Gandharvas; and then he began to cruelly oppress the other celestials with Vishnu at their head.

sa: वृष्टिश्चेन्नानुगृहणीयादनेनास्तत्र कर्षकः। यदन्यः पुरुषः कुर्यात् तत् कृतं सफलं मया॥
en: If however the clouds do not favour him the cultivator is not to blame-he says :-"I have done what others do."

sa: प्रीतास्ते तस्य सत्कारं विधिना पावकोपमाः। उपाजहुश्च सलिलं पुष्पमूलफलं शुचि॥
en: Those fire-like ones gladly gave him a fitting, teçeption in due form. They gave him pure water, fruits, flowers and roots,

sa: तपसोऽन्ते ततस्ताभ्यां स्वयम्भूरदद् वरम्। अगृहणीतां वरं ते तु सुतानामल्पदुःखताम्॥ अवध्यतां च राजेन्द्र सुरराक्षसपन्नगैः। पुरं सुरमणीयं च खचरं सुमहाप्रभम्॥
en: When they had finished their austerities, the self-existent (god) Svayambhu granted them boons. (And), O king of kings, they obtained the boons-viz., that their children might never suffer distress; that (they) might obtain a highly beautiful and an exceedingly splendid aerial city,

sa: केश्युवाच विसृजस्व त्वमेवैनां शत्रैषा प्रार्थिता मया। क्षमं ते जीवतो गन्तुं स्वपुरं पाकशासन॥
en: Keshin said: O chastiser of Paka, leave her alone. I desire to possess her. Do you think that you will be able to return home with your life?

sa: त एते मुदिता राजन्नवध्याः सर्वदैवतैः। निवसन्त्यत्र राजेन्द्र गतोद्वेगा निरुत्सुकाः॥
en: O king of kings, there they dwell happily, indestructible by the gods, free from anxiety and having all their desires fulfilled.

sa: सदैवावां भगिन्यौ तु सखीभिः सह मानसम्। आगच्छावेह रत्यर्थमनुज्ञाप्य प्रजापतिम्॥
en: We, two sisters, always used to come with our maids to this Mandara mountain to sport with the permission of Prajapati.

sa: शान्तनुश्चात्र राजेन्द्र शुनश्च नराधिपः। नरनारायणौ चोभौ स्थान प्राप्ताः सनातनम्॥
en: O king of kings, O ruler of men, Santanu, Sanaka and Nara and Narayana, have obtained eternal regions from this place.

sa: स चतुर्थे ततो वर्षे संगम्य सह भार्यया। सर्वकामैः सुसिद्धार्थो लब्धवान् परमां मुदम्॥
en: Then in the fourth year, (after his exile) king Nala, regained his wife and had all his desires satisfied; and thus once more he enjoyed the highest pleasure.

sa: प्राज्ञास्तात न मुह्यन्ति कालेनापि प्रपीडिताः। एष कालो महाबाहो अपि सर्वदिवौकसाम्॥ मुह्यन्ति हि प्रजास्तात कालेनापि प्रचोदिताः। मा च तत्र विशङ्काभूद् यन्मयोक्तं तवानघ॥
en: O child, the wise men are never be overwhelmed when they are persecuted by Time. O mighty-armed hero, Time rises superior even to the dwellers of heaven. O child, time afflicts all creatures. O sinless one, let not doubt come into your mind regarding what I have told you.

sa: इदं त्वकार्यं कुरुवीरमध्ये रजस्वलां यत् परिकर्षसे माम्। न चापि कश्चित् कुरुतेऽत्र कुत्सां ध्रुवं तवेदं मतमभ्युपेताः॥
en: It is a most unworthy act that you are dragging me before these Kuru heroes, though I am in my season. But none rebukes you here; they are certainly of the same mind with you.

sa: द्रोणस्य भीष्मस्य च नास्ति सत्त्वं क्षत्तुस्तथैवास्य महात्मनोऽपि। राज्ञस्तथा हीममधर्ममुग्रं न लक्षयन्ते कुरुवृद्धमुख्याः॥
en: Drona and Bhisma, Khattwa and also the king (Dhritarashtra) have lost their greatness, else why do these best of the Kuru elders look silently on this great crime.

sa: तत्रापश्यन् दधीचं ते दिवाकरसमद्युतिम्। जाज्वल्यमानं वपुषा यथा लक्ष्या पितामहम्॥
en: They saw there Dadhichi as effulgent as the sun and as blazing in the grace of person as the Grandsire (Brahma).

sa: अवेदयच्च शक्रस्य चित्रसेनोऽपि सर्वशः। तत आनाय्य तनयं विविक्ते हरिवाहनः॥ सान्त्वयित्वा शुभैर्वाक्यैः स्मयमानोऽभ्यभाषत। सुपुत्राद्य पृथा तात त्वया पुत्रेण सत्तम॥
en: Chitrasena also told everything to Shakra (Indra). Then Harivahana (Indra), calling his son in private. And consoling him in sweet words, thus smilingly spoke to him, "O excellent man, O child, having obtained you, Pritha (Kunti) has today became a true mother.

sa: मम प्रतिज्ञां च निबोध सत्यां वृणेधर्मममृताज्जीविताच्च। राज्यं च पुत्राश्च यशोधनं च सर्वं न सत्यस्य कलामुपैति॥
en: Know my promise cannot be made false. I regard Dharma as superior to life itself and divinity. Kingdoms, sons, fame and wealth all these do not come up even to a sixteenth part of truth.

sa: मया तु रक्षिताव्येयं पुरी भरतसत्तम। यावद् राज्ञो हि नीलस्य कुले वंशधरा इति॥
en: I know all your purposes as well as those of the son of Dharma (Yudhishthira). O best of the Bharata race, this city will be protected by me.

sa: पश्चिमे युगकाले च यः स ते सम्प्रकीर्तितः। सर्वलोकस्य विदिता युगसंख्या च पाण्डव॥
en: O son of Pandu, I have now narrated to you everything. I have told you the periods embraced by the several Yugas, that which is known to all.

sa: न सकामाः परे कार्या धर्ममेवाचरोत्तमम्। भ्रातरं धार्मिकं ज्येष्ठं कोऽतिवर्तितुमर्हति॥
en: You should not fulfill the wishes of the enemy. Practise the highest morality. Should any body transgress his virtuous elders brother?

sa: उर्वशीतीर्थमासाद्य ततः सोमाश्रमं बुधः। कुम्भकर्णाश्रमं गत्वा पूज्यते भुवि मानवः॥
en: Going to the Tirtha called Urvashi and then to Somasrama and bathing at Kumbhakarnasrama a wise man becomes adored on earth.

sa: अन्ये च शतशः शूरा विहङ्गाः कामरूपिणः। सर्वान् वो ब्राह्मणैः सार्धं वक्ष्यन्ति सहितानघ॥
en: O sinless one, hundreds of other heroes (Rakshasas), capable of ranging in the skies and of assuming any form at will, will carry you with all the Brahmanas.

sa: स सौबलेयमानाय्य कर्णदुःशासनौ तथा। अब्रवीद् वचनं राजा प्रविश्याबुद्धिजं तमः॥
en: His intelligence, (fully) clouded by ignorance, he summoned the son of Subala (Shakuni), Karna and Dushashana and thus spoke to them.

sa: त्वया ह्यधिगतं तेजः क्षत्रियेभ्यो विशेषतः। पितामहप्रसादेन तेन मां क्षिपसिध्रुवम्॥
en: You have acquired prowess superior to the Kshatriyas through the grace of the Grandsire (Brahma) and therefore you certainly insult me.!

sa: सप्तगोदावरे स्नात्वा नियतो नियताशनः। महत् पुण्यमवाप्नोति देवलोकं च गच्छति॥
en: Bathing in the Sapta Godavari with regulated diet and subdued soul, one obtains great virtue and goes to the celestials region.

sa: इदं चाश्चर्यभूतं मे यत् क्रोधात् तस्यधीमतः। तदैव त्वं न निर्दग्धः सबल: सपदानुगः॥
en: It seems wonder to me that you were not at that very moment consumed by the anger of that wise Agastya together with all your forces and attendants.

sa: तेन पद्मसहस्राणि गवां दश महात्मना। ब्राह्मणानां महाराज दत्तानीति प्रचक्षते॥
en: O great king, that greatly powerful king is said to have given away to the Brahmanas ten thousand Padmas and kine.

sa: ततो हाहेति सहसा मुक्तः शब्दो नराधिपः॥
en: Thereupon all the celestials suddenly gave utterance to their woe by saying, Ah! Alas!!

sa: औद्दालकं महाराज तीर्थं मुनिनिषेवितम्। तत्राभिषेकं कृत्वा वै सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते॥
en: O great king, bathing then in the Tirtha, called Auddalaka, frequented by the Rishis one is cleansed of all his sins.

sa: सहदेव उवाच त्वदर्थोऽयं समारम्भः कृष्णवर्त्मन् नमोऽस्तु ते। मुखं त्वमसि देवानां यज्ञस्त्वमसि पावक॥
en: Sahadeva said O Pavaka, O Krishnavartman, (having) smoke for marking your track, I bow to you. You are the mouth of the celestials; you are the sacrifice itself.

sa: सोमक उवाच कार्यं वा यदि वाकार्यं येन पुत्रशतं भवेत्। कृतमेवेति तद् विद्धि भगवान् प्रब्रवीतु मे॥
en: Somaka said: Whether it is a good or an evil deed, you may consider that the ceremony by which one hundred sons may be born as already performed, O exalted one explain it to me.

sa: ततो ललितकं गच्छेच्छान्तनोस्तीर्थमुत्तमम्। तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् न दुर्गतिमवाप्नुयात्॥
en: Then one should go to the Tirtha of Shantanu, called Lalitaka. O king, bathing there a man never meets with calamity.

sa: अपतत् सहसा भूमौ विसंज्ञोऽथ क्षुधादितः। स्कन्देन सोऽभ्यनुज्ञातो रौद्ररूपोऽभवद् ग्रहः॥
en: He fell down upon the ground senseless and hungry. At the command of Skanda, that evil spirit assumed a fearful form.

sa: यच्च किंचित् तपोयुक्तं फलं तीर्थेषु भारत! ब्रह्मर्षिरेष ब्रूयात् ते तच्छ्रद्धेयं न चान्यथा॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, whatever that Brahmana Rishi would speak about the fruits of asceticism and Tirthas, should be accepted by you with all respect and never otherwise.

sa: शङ्ख च सुमहाभागं वृषसेनं च मानिनम्। एकलव्यं च विक्रान्तं कालिङ्गं च महारथम्॥
en: The greatly prosperous Shankha, the proud Vrishasena, the powerful Ekalavya, the great car-warrior the king of Kalinga, passing over all these powerful men, why do you praise Keshava?

sa: ततः सर्वे समेत्याथ ते नृपास्तं महामुनिम्। इदमूचुर्महाराज समवेक्ष्य परस्परम्॥
en: O great king, then all those monarchs looking at one another and speaking all together thus spoke to the great Rishi.

sa: अभ्यन्तरा च सर्वस्वे द्रौपदी भरतर्षभ। एवं धर्मजितां कृष्णां मन्यसे न जितां कथम्॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, Draupadi is (surely) included in his possessions. Why do you consider that Krishna (Draupadi) who has been righteously won as not won?

sa: इदमभ्यधिकं राजन् ब्राह्मणाः कुरवश्च ते। समेताः कथयन्तीह मुदिताः सत्यसंधताम्॥
en: O king, over and above this the Brahmanas and the Kurus assembling together talk cheerfully of your great adherence to truth.

sa: सोऽहमभ्यागतः क्षिप्रं दिदृक्षुस्त्वां सहाजुनम्। वचनात् पुरुहूतस्य पार्थस्य च महात्मनः॥
en: At the request of Indra and the high-souled Partha. I have speedily come here to see you with your younger brothers.

sa: दह्यमानास्तदास्त्रैस्ते याचन्ति स्मधनंजयम्। ततो ब्रह्मर्षयश्चैव सिद्धा ये च महर्षयः॥
en: And scorched by those (celestials) weapons they prayed to Dhananjaya (to spare their lives). Then the Brahmarshis, the Siddhas, the Maharshis,

sa: भरद्वाजस्तु तच्छ्रुत्वा शूद्रस्य विप्रियं महत्। गतासुं पुत्रमादाय विललाप सुदुःखितः॥
en: Lomasha said: Having hcard from the Shudra, of this great calamity, Bharadvaja, embracing his dead son, began to lament for him.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच यदाभिषिक्तो भगवान सैनापत्येन पावकिः। तदा सम्प्रस्थितः श्रीमान् हृष्टो भद्रवटं हरः॥ रथेनादित्यवर्णेन पार्वत्या सहितः प्रभुः। सहस्रं तस्य सिंहानां तस्मिन् युक्तं रथोत्तमे॥ उत्पपात दिवं शुभं कालेनाभिप्रचोदितम्। ते पिबन्त इवाकाशं त्रासयन्तश्चराचरान्॥
en: When that exalted son of Pavaka was installed as the generallissimo of the celestials army, that handsome and happy lord, riding with Parvati on a car and shining as effulgent as the sun, went to a place called Bhadravata. To his beautiful chariot were yoked thousands of lions and it was driven by Kala (himself). They passed through space and seemed as if they were about to devour the sky.

sa: ततः प्रेम्णा वृत्रशत्रुरर्जुनस्य शुभं मुखम्। पस्पर्श पुण्यगन्धेन करेण परिसान्त्वयन्॥
en: Thereupon consoling him and out of affection, the enemy of Vritra touched the beautiful face of Arjuna with his perfumed hands.

sa: सुराष्ट्रेष्वपि वक्ष्यामि पुण्यान्यायतनानि च। आश्रमान् सरितश्चैव सरांसि च नराधिप॥
en: O ruler of men, I shall now describe the sacred spots and hermitages, rivers and lakes, situated in the Saurashtra country.

sa: ततः प्रवृत्तिः सीताया गृध्रेण सुमहात्मना। सम्पातिना समाख्याता रावणस्य निवेशने॥
en: Thereupon I learned the tidings of Sita from a mighty vulture named Sampati that she was in the abode of Ravana.

sa: आदित्या वसवो रुद्राः साध्याश्च समरुद्गणाः। गन्धर्वाप्सरसश्चैव नित्यं संनिहिता विभो॥
en: O lord, the Adityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, the Sadhyas, the Maruts, the Gandharvas and the Apsaras are always present there.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच किमर्थं भगवान् वह्निः प्रत्यमित्रोऽभवद् युधि। सहदेवस्य यज्ञार्थं घटमानस्य वै द्विज॥
en: Janamejaya said O exalted one, O Brahmana, why was it that the deity Agni became hostile in battle to Sahadeva who fighting for the accomplishment of a sacrifice?

sa: दुहितुर्वचनाद् राजा सोऽगस्त्याय महात्मने। लोपामुद्रां ततः प्रादाद् विधिपूर्वं विशाम्पते॥
en: O king, at the request of his daughter that king then bestowed Lopamudra on the illustrious Agastya with all due rites.

sa: सा स्म दासीशतवृता मध्ये कन्याशतस्य च। आस्ते तेजस्विनी कन्या रोहिणीव दिवि प्रभा॥
en: Surrounded by these one hundred maidservants and remaining in the midst of these one hundred damsels, that effulgent damsel shone, as the brilliant Rohini (star) in the sky.

sa: तं बलौघमपर्यन्तं राजसागरमक्षयम्। कुर्वाणं समयं कृष्णो युद्धाय बुबुधे तदा॥
en: Krishna understood that the undeteriorating great sea of kings with its countless waves of soldiers was making preparation for a fight.

sa: अतिद्यूतं कृतमिदं धार्तराष्ट्रा यस्मात् स्त्रियं विवदध्वं सभायाम्। योगक्षेमौ नश्यतो वः समग्रौ पापान् मन्त्रान् कुरवो मन्त्रयन्ति॥
en: The sons of Dhritarashtra have gambled disregarding every proper consideration. They are now quarrelling in the Sabha over a lady. Your kingdom's prosperity is at an end. Alas! The Kurus are engaged in sinful consultation.

sa: एत एवंविधाः कालाः क्षमायाः परिकीर्तिताः। अतोऽन्यथानुवर्तत्सु तेजसः काल उच्यते॥
en: These have been described as the proper hours of forgiveness; and at other times besides these one should exhibit his prowess.

sa: तरस्वी वैनतेयस्य सदृशो भुवि लङ्घने। उत्पतेदपि चाकाशं निपतेच्च यथेच्छकम्॥
en: He will even leap into the sky and come down at will. O night-rangers, we shall follow him through your prowess.

sa: अपीदानीं मम सुतास्तिष्ठेरन् मन्दचेतसः। येषां भ्राता गुरुज्येष्ठो विनये नावतिष्ठते॥
en: How can my wicked minded sons live when their eldest brother and superior does not walk in the path of righteousness?

sa: विधिना सम्प्रणुदितः शापायास्य मनो दधे। ततः स वार्युपस्पृश्य कोपसंरक्तलोचनः। मैत्रेयोधार्तराष्ट्रं तमशपद् दुष्टचेतसम्॥ यस्मात् त्वं मामनादृत्य नेमां वाचं चिकीर्षसि। तस्मादस्याभिमानस्य सद्यः फलमवाप्नुहि॥
en: And, as if commissioned by fate set his mind to curse him. Thereupon touching water and with eyes red in anger. Maitreya cursed the evil-minded son of Dhritarashtra, saying, "Since slighting my words you decline to follow my advice, you shall soon reap the fruit of your this insolence.

sa: लोमश उवाच उद्दालकस्य नियतः शिष्य एको नाम्ना कहोड इति विश्रुतोऽभूत्। शुश्रूषुराचार्यवशानुवर्ती दीर्घ कालं सोऽध्ययनं चकार॥
en: Lomasha said : Udhalaka had a self-controlled disciple who was known by the name of Kohada. He was entirely devoted to the service of his preceptor and he continued his studies for a long time.

sa: आचार्यं मन्यसे कृष्णमथ वा कुरुनन्दन। द्रोणे तिष्ठति वार्ष्णेयं कस्मादर्चितवानसि॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, if you consider Krishna your preceptor, when Drona is here, how have you worshipped the Vrishni prince?

sa: समुच्छ्रयान् पर्वतसंनिरोधरान् गोष्ठान् हरीणां गिरिसेतुमालाः। बहून् प्रपातांश्च समीक्ष्य वीराः स्थलानि निम्नानि च तत्र तत्र॥ तथैव चान्यानि महावनानि मृगद्विजानेकपसेवितानि। स्तेधन्विनः खड्गधरा नरावयाः॥
en: And those heroes, the excellent of mortals, armed with bows and swords, felt a great delight, beholding (on their way) elevations and defiles, dens of lions, rows of craggy causeways, numerous waterfalls, low lands here and there and various other great forests inhabited by numerous deer, birds and elephants.

sa: विदितश्चैव मेधर्मः सततं चरितश्च ते। जानन्तस्त्वयि शसन्ति सुहृदः कर्मचोदनाम्॥
en: It is well that your conduct is ever regulated by virtue. Knowing this, your sensible friends advise you to act (thus).

sa: भाविन्यर्थे हि सत्स्त्रीणां वैकृतं नोपजायते। गुरुधर्माभिगुप्ता च श्रेयः क्षिप्रमवाप्स्यसि॥
en: The hearts of good woman never moved by what is inevitable. Protected by great virtue, you will soon obtain good fortune.

sa: धन्यां चातीन्द्रियज्ञानामिमां प्राप्तां परां गतिम्। मन्ये तु माद्रीं धर्मज्ञां कल्याणी सर्वथैव तु॥
en: I consider today the virtuous and the blessed Madri as very fortunate, for she had, a fore-knowledge of what would happen and had thus obtained the great emancipation,

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमाश्वास्य राजानं नारदो भगवानृषिः। अनुज्ञाप्य महाराज तत्रैवान्तरधीयत॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having thus comforted the king, O great king, the exalted Rishi Narada, bidding firewell disappeared then and there.

sa: तं जित्वा स महाबाहुः प्रययौ दक्षिणापथम्। गुहामासादयामास किष्किन्धां लोकविश्रुताम्॥
en: Having vanquished him, the mighty armed (hero) went (further) towards the south. He then came to the world-renowned caves of Kishkindhya.

sa: अप्रमत्तेन तत् कार्यमुपदेष्टा पराक्रमः। भूयिष्ठं कर्मयोगेषु दृष्ट एव पराक्रमः॥
en: One should assiduously engage in action, his guide being his prowess; among the qualities necessary for action energy is the foremost.

sa: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु सुराणामृषिसत्तमौ। अटमानौ महात्मानाविन्द्रलोकमितो गतौ॥ नारदः पर्वतश्चैव महाप्राज्ञौ महाव्रतौ। देवराजस्य भवनं विविशाते सुपूजितौ॥
en: At this juncture, those most exalted of the divine sages, the illustrious, greatly wise and austere Narada and Parvata, having arrived at the regions of Indra, obtained admittance into his palace with a respectful reception.

sa: सहदेव निवर्तस्व ननु त्वमसि मे प्रियः। शरीरादपि माद्रेय मा मा त्याक्षीः कुपुत्रवत्॥
en: Sahadeva, you do not go. You are dearer to me than my own body. O son of Madri, do not forsake me; you should be kind to me.

sa: सर्वोपायैर्निहन्तव्याः शत्रवः शत्रुसूदन। पुरा युद्धाद् बलाद् वापि प्रकुर्वन्ति तवाहितम्॥
en: O chastiser of foes, (he said), “Those enemies who always harm by force or stratagem should be destroyed by every means".

sa: सम्प्रक्षालनकालोऽयं लोकानां समुपस्थितः। तस्मात् त्वां बोधयाम्यद्य यत् ते हितमनुत्तमम्॥
en: The proper time for purging off this earth is almost come; therefore I tell you what will be good for you.

sa: मुखमालिप्य तेनासौ सहदेवोऽपि गच्छति॥ नाहं मनांस्याददेयं मार्गे स्त्रीणामिति प्रभो। पांसूपलिप्तसर्वाङ्गो नकुलस्तेन गच्छति॥
en: Sahadeva proceeds along besmearing his face. Nakula goes with his body besmeared with ashes, thinking, “I may steal the hearts of the ladies that may look at me."

sa: ततो दुर्योधनं कर्णः प्रहसन्निदमब्रवीत्। उपायः परिदृष्टोऽयं तं निबोध जनेश्वर।॥
en: Thereupon Karna thus smilingly spoke to Duryodhana, “O ruler of men, a plan has been fixed upon by me. Hear it.

sa: उचितं हि सदा गन्तुं घोषयात्रां विशाम्पते। एवं च त्वां पिता राजन् समनुज्ञातुमर्हति॥
en: O king, O ruler of earth, it is always proper to go and see the cattle; if you say this to your father, you will get his permission."

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य सुदेवस्य विशाम्पते। सुनन्दा शोधयामास पिप्लुप्रच्छादनं मलम्॥
en: O monarch! Sunanda, having heard the words of Sudeva, cleaned the dust that soiled ile freckle (between the eye-brows of Damayanti).

sa: अचिराद् भगवन् भौममिदं स्थावरजङ्गमम्। सर्वमेव महाभाग प्रलयं वै गमिष्यति॥
en: O exalted one, O greatly blessed one; the dissolution of all this mobile and immobile world is now near at hand.

sa: स घृतेन जितो भ्रात्रा हृतराज्यो महीपतिः। दमयन्त्या गतः सार्धं न प्राज्ञायत कस्यचित्॥
en: That ruler of the earth was defeated at dice by his brother; and, thereby deprived of his kingdom, went away with Damayanti without the knowledge of any body.

sa: दोषस्यैतस्य वै ब्रह्मन् विघाते यत्नवानहम्। विधिना हि हते पूर्वं निमित्तं घातको भवेत्॥
en: O Brahmana, I am always assiduous in eradicating this evil. The Destiny has already killed one when he is killed by another, the executioner is but an instrument.

sa: तदलं साधु युद्धेन निवर्तस्व जनार्दन। द्वारकामेव रक्षस्व कार्यमेतन्महत् तव॥
en: O Janardana, therefore there is no need of fighting here. Cease fighting and defend Dvarka. This is (now) your principal duty.”

sa: धर्म एव प्लवो नान्यः स्वर्ग द्रौपदि गच्छताम्। सैव नौः सागरस्येव वणिजः पारमिच्छतः॥
en: O Draupadi, virtue is the only raft and nothingelse to those who wish to go to heaven, like a ship to the merchant wishing to cross the Ocean.

sa: निमित्तभूता हि वयं कर्मणोऽस्य द्विजोत्तम। येषां हतानां मांसानि विक्रीणामीह वै द्विज॥ तेषामपि भवेद् धर्म उपयोगे न भक्षणे। देवतातिथिभृत्यानां पितृणां चापि पूजनम्॥
en: O foremost of Brahmanas, we are but such agents in consequence of our Karma, O twiceborn one, those animals that are killed and the most of which are sold, also acquire Karma, for the celestials the guests and servants are entertained and Pitris are gratified with this dainty food.

sa: तान् विगाहस्व पार्थाद्य तपसा च दमेन च। रक्ष्यमाणो मया राजन् भीमसेनबलेन च॥
en: O king, protected by me, as well as by the prowess of Bhimasena and also in consequence of your own asceticism and sclf-command, do mix with them today.

sa: विलग्नमध्यश्च स नाभिदेशे कटिश्च तस्यातिकृतप्रमाणा। तथास्य चीरान्तरतः प्रभाति हिरण्मयी मेखला मे यथेयम्॥
en: His waist was slender, his navel heat and region about the ribs smooth. There shone a golden string from under his cloth like this waist string of mine.

sa: दक्षिणस्यां दिशि यमं प्रत्यपश्यं व्यवस्थितम्। वरुणं देवराजं च यथास्थानमवस्थितम्॥
en: (And) I beheld Yama seated towards the southern point and the king of the gods and Varuna in their respective places.

sa: इत्युक्तः पाण्डवेयेन किरातः प्रहसन्निव। उवाच श्लक्ष्णया वाचा पाण्डवं सव्यसाचिनम्॥
en: Having been thus addressed by the Pandava, the Kirata spoke to the son of Pandu, Savyasachi (Arjuna), in these sweet words.

sa: शासनं सततं चक्रुस्तथैव भरतर्षभाः। भुञ्जाना मुनिभोज्यानि रसवन्ति फलानि च॥
en: Living on the food eaten by the sages and luscious fruits and the flesh of the deer killed by unpoisoned arrows.

sa: न तानि सेवेत मुनिर्यतात्मा सतां लोकान् प्रार्थयानः कथंचित्। कृत्वा त्रिनं तापसानां रमन्ते पापाचारास्तापसस्तान् न पश्येत्॥
en: The self-controlled Rishis who desire to obtain the region of the righteous never serve them. Those sinful beings take pleasure in obstructing the practices of the ascetics and (therefore) the ascetics do not see them.

sa: तद् धनौघमपर्यन्तं पार्थः पार्थिवमण्डले। विसृजशुशुभे राजन् यथा वैश्रवणस्तथा ॥
en: Indeed, Prithas son, by distributing that untold riches among the invited kings, shone, O king, like Vaishravana, the lord of riches.

sa: संहत्य कुर्वते यात्रां सहिताः संघचारिणः। संघातवृत्तयो ह्येते वर्तन्ते हेत्वहेतुभिः॥
en: They travel together, in union, and moving collectively. They move in a body; when they act with cause or without cause.

sa: पितरश्च महाभागा ऋषयश्च तपोधनाः। गृह्याश्च देवताः सर्वाः प्रीयन्ते विधिनार्चिताः॥
en: When adored with proper rites, the highlyblessed departed Manes, Rishis having asceticism for wealth, and the household deities, all become pleased.

sa: प्रकाशं सर्वभूतेषु लाघवं श्रद्दधानता। सात्त्विक रूपमेवं तु लाघवं साधुसम्मितम्॥
en: Splendour, lightness, and faith-these are the form, that is light, of Goodness among all creatures, as considered by all good men.

sa: ततः स भुक्त्वा भगवान् दम्पती प्राह धर्मवित्। स्वप्तुमिच्छाम्यहं निद्रा बाधते मामिति प्रभो॥
en: Having finished his meals, the holy Chyavana, knowing every duty, addressed the king and the queen, saying I wish to sleep, O powerful one, sleep hinders me now.

sa: ततः प्रहस्य जनकं ब्राह्मणः पुनरब्रवीत्। तवज्जिज्ञासार्थमोह विद्धि मां धर्ममागतम्॥
en: The Brahmana then, smiling, once more said to Janaka, Know that I am Dharma, who come here today for examining you.

sa: योनिष्वेतासु सर्वासु संकीर्णास्वितरासु च। यत्रात्मानं न जनयेद् बुधस्तां परिवर्जयेत्॥
en: For these reasons the wise should avoid those women among these various castes mixed, upon whom they should not beget children.

sa: यो न कामयते किंचिन्न किंचिदवमन्यते। इहलोकस्थ एवैष ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते॥
en: He who never desires for anything, who despises nothing, becomes eligible, even when living in this world, for assimilation with Brahma.

sa: अविषह्यं च राजा हि तीन चारप्स्यते तपः। एतच्छ्रुत्वा महाबाहुः सहदेवो युधां पतिः॥ युधिष्ठिरमुवाचेदं बाष्पव्याकुललोचनः। नोत्सहेऽहं परित्यक्तुं मातरं भरतर्षभ॥
en: The king will commence to practice the most austere and unbearable of penances!' Hearing these words, that king of battle, the mighty-armed Shadeva with eyes bathed in tears, addressed Yudhishthira, saying, 'O chief of Bharata race, I dare not leave my mother.

sa: एवं व्युत्थापिते धर्मे ज्ञानं संन्यासमित्येके स्वभावं भूतचिन्तकाः। सर्वमेके प्रशंसन्ति न सर्वमिति चापरे।॥
en: Some say that knowledge and renunciation (should be followed). Others who ponder on the elements, say that it is nature. Some speak too much of everything. Others, nothing.

sa: क्षत्रियायास्तथा वैश्या न जातु सदृशी भवेत्। श्रीश्च राज्यं च कोशश्च क्षत्रियाणां युधिष्ठिर।॥
en: Likewise, the Vaishya wife cannot be considered as the equal of the Kshatriya wife in point of birth. Prosperity, kingdom and treasury, ( Yudhishthira, belong to the Kshatriyas.

sa: सौतिरुवाच इत्युक्तवचने तस्मिन् नृपे व्यासः प्रतापवान्। प्रसादमकरोद् धीमानानयच्च परीक्षितम्॥
en: Sauti said After king Janamejaya had said these words, the highly energetic and intelligent Vyasa, showed his favour and brought Parikshit.

sa: सौतिरुवाच एतच्छुत्वा नृपो विद्वान् हृष्टोऽभूज्जनमेजयः। पितामहानां सर्वेषां गमनागमनं तदा॥
en: Santi said Hearing this story of the reappearance and departure of his forefathers, the highly intelligent king Janamejaya became greatly pleased.

sa: तस्य सर्वस्य विधिवद् विधानमुपदिश्यते। शृणु मे गदतो भद्रे रहस्यमिदमद्भुतम्॥
en: The ordinances are now being duly declared in full. Listen to me, O fair lady, as I describe this wonderful mystery.

sa: ततस्ते पार्थिवाः सर्वे भीष्मद्रोणपुरोगमाः। ससैन्याः सलिलात् तस्मात् समुत्तस्थुः सहस्रशः॥
en: Then those kings, headed by Bhishma and Drona, with all their armies, arose by thousands from the waters of the Bhagirathi.

sa: नितम्भूर्भुवनो धौम्यः शतानन्दोऽकृतव्रणः। जामदग्न्यस्तथा रामः कचश्चेत्येवमादयः॥
en: There also Nitambhu Bhuvana, Dhaumya, Shatananda, Akritavrana, Rama the son of Jamadagni and Kacha.

sa: धर्म:सहायश्च एकस्तरति दुर्गाणि गच्छत्येकस्तु दुर्गतिम्। असहाय: पिता माता तथा भ्राता सुतो गुरुः॥ ज्ञातिसम्बन्धिवर्गश्च मित्रवर्गस्तथैव च। मृतं शरीरमुत्सृज्य काष्ठलोष्टसमं जनाः॥ मुहूर्तमिव रोदित्वा ततो यान्ति पराङ्मुखः।
en: One has really no companion in these deeds. The father the mother, the brother, the son the preceptor kinsmen, relatives and friends, leaving the dead body as if it were a piece of wood or a clod of earth, after having mourned for only a moment, all turn away from it and mind their own affairs.

sa: ततो धर्मसमायुक्तः प्राप्नुते जीव एव हि॥ ततोऽस्य कर्म पश्यन्ति शुभं वा यदि वाशुभम्। देवताः पञ्चभूतस्थाः किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि॥
en: Gifted with merit (and demerit) individual soul (after the destruction of this body) comes by another body. After the attainment by individual soul of that body the presiding deities of the five elements once more witness all his deeds, good and bad.

sa: कर्मणा येन येनेह यस्यां योनौ प्रजायते। जीवो मोहसमायुक्तस्तन्मे निगदतः शृणु॥ यदेतदुच्यते शास्त्रे सेतिहासे च च्छन्दसि। यमस्य विषयं घोरं मया लोकः प्रपद्यते॥
en: Listen to me as I tell you, what the different acts are by doing which individuals soul, Stupefied by folly, has to take birth in different orders of being, as declared in the Vedas, the scriptures, and the histories, Mortals have to go to the dreadful regions of Yama.

sa: पार्थिवो यस्तु गन्धो वै घ्राणेन हि स गृह्यते। घ्राणस्थश्च तथा वायुर्गन्धज्ञाने विधीयते॥
en: Smell, which belongs to earth, is seized by the nose. The wind, which dwells in the nose is likewise appointed as an agent) in the perception of smell.

sa: मातापितरावाश्य सारिकः सम्प्रजायते। ताडयित्वा तु तावेव जायते कच्छपो नृप॥
en: Having spoken ill of parents one is born as a Sarika. Striking them one is born, O king as a tortoise.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। दम्पत्योः पार्थ संवादो योऽभवद् भरतर्षभ॥
en: Regarding it is cited the old narrative, O son of Pritha, of the discourse that took place between a married couple.

sa: अयो हत्वा तु दुर्बुद्धिर्वायसो जायते नरः। कांस्यं हत्वा तु दुर्बुद्धिरेरितो जायते नरः॥
en: That littlewitted man who steals iron has to take birth as a cow. That man who steals white brass, is born as a bird of the Harita spccies.

sa: इमां च देवीं पश्यामि वपुषाप्सरसोपमाम्। श्रिया परमया युक्तां यथा दृष्टा पुरा मया।॥
en: I see my goddess become as beautiful in body as an Apsara. Indeed, she is endued with as much beauty and splendour as she had ever been before.

sa: कृमिर्भवति वर्षाणि दश पञ्च च भारत। ततो गर्भं समासाद्य तत्रैव म्रियते शिशुः॥
en: He has to live as a vile vermin for a period of fifteen years, O Bharata. He has then to enter the womb and dic prematurely before birth.

sa: उत्तङ्क उवाच अभिजानामि जगतः कर्तारं त्वां जनार्दन। नूनं भवत्प्रसादोऽयमिति मे नास्ति संशयः॥
en: Utanka said I know you, O Janardana, to be the creator of the universe. Forsooth, this knowledge that I have is the result of your grace towards me.

sa: तानपृच्छत् ततो राजा क्वासौ कौरववंशभृत्। पिता ज्येष्ठो गतोऽस्माकमिति बाष्पपरिप्लुतः॥
en: The king, with tears in his eyes, asked them, saying, 'Where has my eldest sire the perpetuator of Kuru's race, gone?

sa: ब्राह्मणा एव जायेरन् पुण्यवाग्बुद्धिकर्मणः॥ उत्सहेदिह कृत्वैव कोऽन्यो वै च्यवनादृते।
en: Only Brahmanas are born in this world for uttering and understanding sacred deeds. Who else save Chyavana could do all this?

sa: अचिन्तयंश्च जननी ततस्ते पाण्डुनन्दनाः। कथं नु वृद्धमिथुनं वहत्यतिकृशा पृथा॥
en: Thinking of their mother, the sons of Pandu became anxious as to how their emaciated mother was serving the old pair.

sa: सर्वं तत्त्वेन धर्मज्ञ यथावदिह धर्मतः। किं च भक्ष्यमभक्ष्यं वा सर्वमेतद् वदस्व मे॥
en: You know every duty. Describe to me, in full according to the ordinances on duty, this subject. Do tell me what indeed is edible and what inedible ?

sa: न च तत्रापि संतोषो दृष्ट्रा दीप्ततरां श्रियम्। इत्येता गतयः सर्वाः पृथक्ते समुदीरिताः॥
en: There is discontent at sight of prosperity more burning than one's own even in the celestial region. Even these are the goals which I have mentioned in full.

sa: कर्मक्षयाच्च ते सर्वे च्यवन्ते वै पुनः पुनः। तत्रापि च विशेषोऽस्ति दिवि नीचोच्चमध्यमः॥
en: Upon the termination, again, of their merits, they fall away from those regions repeatedly. There is distinction of inferior, superior and middling happiness even in the celestial region.

sa: क्षत्रियाणां तु यो दृष्टो विधिस्तमपि मे शृणु॥ वीर्येणोपार्जितं मांसं यथा भुञ्जन्न दुष्यति।
en: Listen to me as I tell you what the ordinances is for the Kshatriyas. They do not commit any sin by eating flesh that has been acquired power.

sa: यदायमतिकष्टानि सर्वाण्युपनिषेवते। अत्यथैमपि वा भुङ्क्ते न वा भुक्तो कदाचन॥
en: At such a time he does practices that are greatly harmful. He sometimes eats excessively and sometimes abstains altogether from food.

sa: कश्यप उवाच कथं शरीरं च्यवते कथं चैवोपपद्यते। कथं कष्टाच्च संसारात् संसरन् परिमुच्यते॥
en: Kashyapa said How does the body dissolve away, and how is another is acquired? How does one become liberated after passing through a repeated round of painful re-births?

sa: दुःखं प्राणपरित्यागः पुरुषाणां महामृधे। जानासि त्वं महाप्राज्ञ प्राणत्यागं सुदुष्करम्॥ समृद्धौ वासमृद्धौ वा शुभे वा यदि वाऽशुभे। कारणं तत्र में ब्रूहि सर्वज्ञो ह्यसि मे मतः॥
en: To give up life in battle is fraught with sorrow for men. O you of great wisdom you know that to give up life if difficult for men whether they are rich or poor or are in happiness or misery. In my opinion you are gifted with omniscience. Do you tell me the reason of this.

sa: नहुषस्तु ततः श्रुत्वा महर्षेर्वचनं नृप। हर्षेण महता युक्तः सहामात्यपुरोहितः॥
en: Hearing these words of the great Rishi, Nahusha became, O king, filled with joy along with all his counsellors and priest.

sa: तत: शिखण्डी गाङ्गेयं युध्यमानं महाहवे। जघान बहुभिर्बाणैः सह गाण्डीवधन्वना॥
en: Then Shikhandin, in great battle, hciped by the holder of Gandiva, killed, with innumerable arrows, the son of Ganga, fighting bravely.

sa: हते शल्ये तु शकुनि सहदेवो महात्मनाः। आहर्तारं कलेस्तस्य जघानामितविक्रमः॥
en: After the fall of Shalya, the great Sahadeva, of immeasurable prowess, killed Shakuni the man who had brought about the quarrel.

sa: हतशिष्टेन सैन्येन समन्तात् पर्यवार्य तम्। अथोपविविशुर्हष्टा हृदस्थं पञ्च पाण्डवाः॥
en: With the residue of their army, the Pandavas surrounded the lake and, filled with joy, met Duryodhana concealed within the waters.

sa: हतपुत्रा हतबला हतमित्रा मया सह। युयुधानसहायेन पञ्च शिष्टास्तु पाण्डवाः॥
en: Their sons killed, their forces killed, their friends killed, only the five sons of Pandu, are alive with myself and Yuyudhana.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच विजिते पाण्डवै राजन् प्रशान्ते च विशाम्पते। राष्ट्र बभूवतुर्हष्टौ वासुदेवधनंजयौ॥ विजह्राते मुदा युक्तौ दिवि देवेश्वराविव। तौ वनेषु विचित्रेषु पर्वतेषु ससानुपु॥ तीर्थेषु चैव पुण्येषु पल्वलेषु नदीषु च। चक्रम्यमाणौ संहृष्टावश्विनाविव नन्दने॥
en: Vaishmpayana said. O king, Vasudeva and Dhananjaya were highly pleased when the Pandavas had succeeded in regaining and pacifying their kingdoms, and they deported themselves with great glcc, like Indra and his wife in the celestial regions, and amidst picturesque forest scenarios, and tablelands of mountains, and sacred places of pilgrimage, and lakes and rivers, they travelled with great pleasure like the two Ashvins in the Nandana garden of Indra.

sa: तत्रैव न्यवसत् कृष्णः स्वर्चितः पुरुषोत्तमः। विदुरेण महातेजास्तथैव च युयुत्सुना॥
en: That foremost of men, viz., Krishna of great energy, worshipped by Vidura and Yuyutsu, continued to live in the Kuru capital.

sa: ततः कृष्णं समासाद्य कुन्तिभोजसुता तदा। प्रोवाच राजशार्दूल बाप्पगद्गदया गिरा॥
en: Mecting Krishna, Kunti, that daughter of the Bhoja race, said to him in a voice choked with tears, Oforemost of monarchs.

sa: भीष्म उवाच एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु वचनं तमुवाच पुरंदरः। मतङ्ग दुर्लभमिदं विप्रत्वं प्रार्थ्यते त्वया॥
en: Bhishma said Hearing these words of his, Purandara said to him The dignity of a Brahmana, O Matanga, which you wish to acquire, cannot be won by you.

sa: अभिमन्योः सुतो वीर न संजीवति यद्ययम्। जीवति त्वयि दुर्धर्ष किं करिष्याम्यहं त्वया॥
en: If, O hero, this son of Abhimanyu does not revive when you, O irresistible one, are alive and near, of what other use will you be to me?

sa: यदर्थं मां प्राहिणोत् त्वत्सकाशं बृहस्पतिं परिदातुं मरुत्ते। अयं गुरुर्याजयतां नृप त्वां मर्यं सन्तममरं त्वां करोतु॥
en: And the object for which he has sent me to you is to present Brihaspati to Marutta; O prince, let this priest perform your sacrifice, and make you who are only a mortal, attain immortality.

sa: यावच्च जायते मर्त्यस्तावच्छूरो भविष्यति। इदं चाप्यपरं गुह्यं सरहस्यं निबोधत॥
en: Every time he is born in this world, he becomes celebrated for his heroism. Hear of another mystery unknown to all.

sa: त्वं भूतानामधिपतिस्त्वयि लोकाः प्रतिष्ठिताः। नमुचेर्विश्वरूपस्य निहन्ता त्वं बलस्य च॥
en: You are the Lord of creatures, and in you are the worlds established. And you have killed Namuchi Vishvarupa and Vala.

sa: उपानहौ च च्छत्रं च प्रतिगृौर्ध्वदेहिके। जपेच्छतं समायुक्तस्तेन मुच्येत पाप्मना॥
en: In accepting shoes or clothes at obsequial ceremonies, the sin is dissipated by reciting devoutly the same hymn a hundred times.

sa: कुटुम्बतन्त्रे तदा सहदेवं युधां पतिम्। अनुमान्य महीपालं धृतराष्ट्र युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: With the permission of king Dhritarashtra, Yudhishthira then set Sahadeva, that foremost of warriors, to wait upon all the invited guests.

sa: स हयः पृथिवीं राजन् प्रदक्षिणमवर्तत। ससारोत्तरतः पूर्वं तन्निबोध महीपते॥
en: The horse, O king, travelled over the whole Earth. Know, O monarch, that from the north it turned towards the East.

sa: एतस्मात् कारणाद् देवा गन्धर्वोरगराक्षसाः। मनुष्याश्च पिशाचाश्च प्रयता धारयन्ति तत्॥
en: It is therefore that the celestial and Gandharvas and Uragas and Rakshasas and human beings and Pishachas hold it with care.

sa: काशिराज्यं तदद्यैव त्वदर्थं जीवितं तथा। त्यजेयं भव विश्रब्धः कपोत न भयं तव॥
en: I shall, for your sake give up today the very kingdom of the Kashis and, if necessary my life too! Be comforted, therefore, do no fear, O pigeon.

sa: कारयेयाश्च कर्माणि युक्तायुक्तैरधिष्ठितैः। सेनाप्रणेता च भवेत् तव तात दृढव्रतः॥
en: The commandant of your army should be of firm conduct, courageous, capable of bearing hardships, loyal, and devoted to your wellbeing.

sa: सुवर्णदानेऽकरवं मतिं च भरतर्षभ। इतिहासमिमं चापि शृणु राजन् पुरातनम्॥
en: Indeed, O chief of Bharata's race, I determined upon making gifts of gold, Listen now, O king, to this old history.

sa: इमे ते लोकधर्मार्थं त्रयः सृष्टाः स्वयम्भुवा। पृथिव्यां सर्जने नित्यं सृष्टांस्तानपि मे शृणु॥
en: For the sake of the virtue, three religions were created by the self-create. Whenever the world is created, those Religions are created by the Grand-father. Do you listen.

sa: पुत्रसंस्थं च विपुलं राज्यं विप्रोषिते त्वयि। त्रयोदशसमा भुक्तं दत्तं च विविधं वसु॥
en: Having obtained a good number of children and a prosperous kingdom, he enjoyed great riches for thirteen years while you were in exile, and gave away much wealth.

sa: पुरन्दरश्च तत्रस्थो बभूव विमना भृशम्। स तद्वैकृतमालक्ष्य देवराजो विशाम्पते॥
en: Observing that awkward result, the king of the celestials, O monarch, having a thousand eyes, saw everything with his spiritual eye.

sa: न ह्यधर्मतयाधर्मे दद्यात् काल: कथंचन। तस्माद् विशुद्धमात्मानं जानीयाद् धर्मचारिणम्॥
en: Time can never make the cause of misery. One should, therefore, know that the soul which is virtuous is certainly pure.
