sa: सदा हि गत्वा ते वीराः पर्युपासन्त तं नृपम्। पादाभिवादनं कृत्वा धर्मराजमते स्थिताः॥
en: Those heroes used very often to go to that king and sit beside him, after having adored his feet, according to the wishes of king Yudhishthira the just.

sa: विग्रहं पूजयेद् यो वै लिङ्गं वापि महात्मनः। लिङ्गं पूजयिता नित्यं महतीं श्रियमश्नुते॥
en: If there is one who adorcs him by creating his image, and another who adores his emblem, the latter it is who wins great prosperity for ever. VOW

sa: यदुस्तस्मान्महासत्त्वः क्रोष्टा तस्माद् भविष्यति। क्रोष्टुश्चैव महान् पुत्रो वृजिनीवान् भविष्यति॥
en: From Yayati will spring a powerful son named Yadu. Yadu will beget Kroshtri. Kroshtri will beget a powerful son named Vrijinivat.

sa: वृजिनीवतश्च भविता उषड्गुरपराजितः। उषगोर्भविता पुत्रः शूरचित्ररथस्तथा॥
en: Vrijinivat will beget beget the invincible Ushadgu. Ushadgu will beget a son named Chitraratha.

sa: अन्धेन तमसा लोकाः प्रावृता न चकाशिरे। प्रणष्टा ज्योतिषां भाश्च सह सूर्येण भारत॥
en: All the worlds became covered with darkness. Nothing could be seen. The light of all the luminaries became darkened, along with that of the Sun himself, O Bharata.

sa: अपि कृत्वा नरः पापं भूमि दत्त्वा द्विजातये। समुत्सृजति तत् पापं जीर्णो त्वचमिवोरगः॥
en: If after committing numerous sins a person makes gifts of carth to the twiceborn class, he leaves off all those sins like a snake casting off its slough.

sa: शरभेणार्चितस्तत्र शिशुपालसुतेन सः। युद्धपूर्वं तदा तेन पूजया च महाबलः॥
en: Sharabha, the son of Shishupala, gifted with great strength, first met Arjuna in battle and then adored him with due honours.

sa: भीष्म उवाच इममर्थं पुरा पृष्टो नारदो देवदर्शनः। यदुक्तवानसौ वाक्यं तन्मे निगदतः शृणु॥
en: Bhishma said These very questions were formerly put by me to Narada. Hear me as I recite to you what that celestial sage had told me in reply.

sa: भीष्म उवाच इत्येतद् वचनं श्रुत्वा मेदिन्या मधुसूदनः। साधु साध्विति कौरव्य मेदिनीं प्रत्यपूजयत्॥
en: Bhishma said Hearing those words of the goddess Earth, the destroyer of Madhu, O you of Kuru's race, said, Excellent, Excellent! and honoured the goddess in due form.

sa: आससाद हयः श्रीमान् कुरुराजस्य यज्ञियः। तमुन्मथ्य हयश्रेष्ठं यादवानां कुमारकाः॥
en: When the beautiful sacrificial horse of the Kuru king reached Dvaravati, the Yadava youths, used force against that foremost of horses.

sa: ततो दीनान् पशून् दृष्ट्वा ऋषयस्ते तपोधनाः। ऊचुः शक्रं समागम्य नायं यज्ञविधिः शुभः॥
en: Seeing that the animals had all become dispirited, those Rishis, gifted with wealth of penances, approached Shakra and said to him, “This method of sacrifice is not auspicious.'

sa: जनमेजय उवाच यज्ञो सक्ता नृपतयस्तप:सक्ता महर्षयः शान्तिव्यवस्थिता विप्राः शमे दम इति प्रभो॥
en: Janamejaya said O powerful Rishi, kings are attached to sacrifices. The great Rishis are attached to penances. Learned Brahmanas observe tranquillity of mind, peacefulness of conduct and self-control.

sa: स च तैर्व्यथितः शक्रो वसिष्ठं शरणं ययौ। ततोऽभयं ददौ तैभ्यो वसिष्ठो भगवानृषिः॥
en: Shakra, however, was soon afflicted by them. In his distress he sought the protection of Vasishtha. At this, the holy Rishi Vasishtha assured the celestials, removing their fears.

sa: ताः कामलुब्धाः प्रमदाः प्रबाधन्ते नरान् सदा। क्रोधं कामस्य देवेशः सहायं चासृजत् प्रभुः॥
en: Tempted by the desire of enjoyment, they began to pursue persons of the other sex. The powerful lord of the deities created Anger as the companion of Lust.

sa: ततो नियुक्ताः पशवो यथाशास्त्रं मनीषिभिः। तं तं देवं समुद्दिश्य पक्षिणः पशवश्च ये॥
en: Following the injunctions of the scriptures, the priests endued with great learning then duly tied to the stakes both animals and birds, assigning each to its particular deity.

sa: अनुज्ञात: स कृष्णेन नमस्कृत्य जनार्दनम्। दिव्यमास्थाय पन्थानं ययौ दिवमरिंदमः॥
en: Permitted then by Krishna, king Nriga bowed his head to him and then mounted a celestial car and went to Heaven.

sa: उद्धृत्य तु वपा तस्य यथाशास्त्रं द्विजातयः॥ श्रपयामासुरव्यग्रा विधिवद् भरतर्षभ।
en: The Brahmanas then, with cool minds, taking up the marrow of that horse, cooked it duly, O chief of Bharata's race.

sa: नाधयो व्याधयश्चैव रामे राज्यं प्रशासति। पक्क सस्या वसुमती सर्वोषधिसमन्विता॥
en: For there was neither decease nor poverty in the kingdorm. During Rama's regime, the earth was filled with corns and Asadhis.

sa: दीर्यन्ते किं नु गिरयः किंस्विद् भूमिर्विदीर्यते। किंस्विदापूर्यते व्योम जलधाराघनैर्घनैः॥
en: "Are mountains splitting? Is the earth going to be rent asunder? Is the sky resounding with the roar of gathering clouds?”

sa: जीविते परमं दुःखं जीविते परमो ज्वरः। जीविते वर्तमानस्य ध्रुवः॥
en: To live is to suffer great misery; to live is to suffer great diseases. Life is certainly a record of sorrows.

sa: ततो युधिष्ठिरः पूर्वं धनुर्गृह्य परंतपः। तस्थौ भासं समुद्दिश्य गुरुवाक्यप्रचोदितः॥
en: The chastiser of foes, Yudhisthira, first took up the bow as ordered by his preceptor and stood aiming at the bird.

sa: जातपुत्रा च वृद्धा च प्रियकामा च ते सदा। समीक्ष्यैतदहं सर्वं व्यवसायं करोम्यतः॥
en: I have borne son and I have grown old; I am ever desirous of doing good to you. Having considered all this, I have come to this resolution.

sa: दृष्ट्वा स पुनरेवर्निदीं हैमवतीं तदा। चण्डग्राहवती भीमां तस्याः स्रोतस्यपातयत्॥
en: Seeing once more the river Himavati of terrible appearance and full of fierce animals, the Rishi threw himself into its waters.

sa: अङ्गारपर्णं निर्जित्य गङ्गाकूलेऽर्जुनस्तदा। सख्यं कृत्वा ततस्तेन तस्मादेव च शुश्रुवे॥
en: The victory of Arjuna over Angaraparna on the banks of the Bhagirathi; making friendship with him and to hear from him.

sa: उवाच मतिमान् राजा भीमं भीमपराक्रमः। भीम योत्स्ये त्वया सार्धं श्रेयसा निर्जितं वरम्॥
en: The terribly powerful and intelligent king then thus spoke to Bhima, “O Bhima, I shall fight with you. It is better to be vanquished by a superior man."

sa: इति शप्तो महातेजा भृगुणा पूर्वजन्मनि॥ इहागतो हि पुत्रत्वं तव पार्थिवसत्तम। राम इत्यभिविख्यातस्त्रिषु लोकेषु मानद ॥
en: O bestower of kings, the highly effulgent Vişnu, thus imprecated by Bhrgu in the days of yore, has been born as your son in this birth and has been celebrated under the appellation of Rama.

sa: तत्र चक्रममाणौ तौ वसुदेवसुतां शुभाम्। अलंकृतां सखीमध्ये भद्रां ददृशतुस्तदा॥
en: When thus walking about, they saw the beautiful daughter of Vasudeva, Subhadra, adorned with ornaments in the midst of her companions.

sa: वदध्वं वाचि वीर्यं च ब्राह्मणस्य विशेषतः। कर्म चैतद् विलिङ्गस्थं किं वोऽद्य प्रसमीक्षितम्॥
en: The prowess of a Brahmana rests mainly in his speech. Your action does not suit the order you profess to belong. Tell me what is your object today.

sa: एवमुक्ते ततः कृष्णः प्रत्युवाच महामनाः। स्निग्धगम्भीरया वाचा वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः॥
en: Having been thus addressed, the high minded Krishna, well-skilled in speech, thus replied to him in a calm and grave voice.

sa: विस्तरं कुरुवंशस्य गान्धार्या धर्मशीलताम्॥ क्षत्तुः प्रज्ञां धृति कुन्त्याः सम्यग्द्वैपायनोऽब्रवीत्।
en: Vyasa has fully described the greatness of the Kuru race, virtues of Gandhari, the wisdom of Vidura and constancy of Kunti.

sa: तां प्रेक्ष्य पतितामा" पौरजानपदो जनः। सरोद दुःखसंतप्तो राजभक्त्या कृपान्वितः॥
en: Seeing her prostrate on the ground the citizens and the people wept in grief or the affection they for the king.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच पाण्डवास्तु रथान् युक्तान् सदश्वैरनिलोपमैः। आरोहमाणा भीष्मस्य पादौ जगृहुरार्तवत्॥ राज्ञश्च धृतराष्ट्रस्य द्रोणस्य च महात्मनः। अन्येषां चैव वृद्धानां कृपस्य विदुरस्य च॥ एवं सर्वान् कुरून् वृद्धानभिवाद्य यतव्रताः। समालिङ्गय समानान् वै बालैश्चाप्यभिवादितः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : The Pandavas got on their cars yoked with fine horses having the speed like that of the wind, When ascending (the car), they touched in grief the feet of Bhishma, of the king Dhritarashtra, of the high-souled Drona, Kripa and Vidura and of all the other old men. Thus duly saluting all the elders of the Kuru race, embracing the equals, being saluted by even the boys.

sa: जरयाहं प्रतिच्छन्नो वयोरूपधरस्तव। यौवनं भवते दत्त्वा चरिष्यामि यथाऽऽत्थ माम्॥
en: "Attacked by your old age, deprived of youth and beauty, I shall at your command live and give you my youth.”

sa: एष तूशनसा मुक्तः शापोत्सर्गो ययातिना। धारितः क्षत्रधर्मेण यं निमिश्चक्षमे न च ॥
en: In this wise, according to the custom of the Kșatriya the king Yayāti took upon himself the imprecation of the preceptor śukra, but he did not forgive him.

sa: तथेति च वचस्तस्यास्त्वयाप्युक्तं पितामह। एतदिच्छामि विज्ञातुं कारणं यन्न वारिता॥
en: O Grandsire, you have also said, “Be it so." We wish to know the reason why you did not prevent her,

sa: तेनाभिपतिता दावं शैलेन महता भृशम्। शृङ्गेण निहतास्तत्र प्राणिनः खाण्डवालयाः॥
en: The fragments of that huge peak fell down on that forest and they killed numerous creatures, the dwellers of the Khandava.

sa: सा तु सूतस्य वचनादारुरोह रथोत्तमम्॥ सीता सौमित्रिणा सार्धं सुमन्त्रेण च धीमता। आससाद विशालाक्षी गङ्गां पापविनाशिनीम्।।२३
en: According to the request of the intelligent charioteer, Sītā, with Lakşmaņa, ascended that excellent conveyance. In no time the daughter of Janaka, having expansive eyes, arrived at the banks of the Gangā removing all sins.

sa: दीप्तोर्ध्वकेशः पिङ्गाक्षः पिबन् प्राणभृतां वसाम्। तां स कृष्णार्जुनकृतां सुधां प्राप्य हुताशनः॥ बभूव मुदितस्तृप्तः परां निर्वृतिमागतः।
en: Agni with fiery hair on his head, drank with the assistance of Krishna and Arjuna that nectar-like stream of fat. He was filled with great joy and thus being much gratified, he enjoyed much happiness.

sa: प्रसीद नः पतगपते प्रयाचतां शिवश्च नो भव भगवन्सुखावहः। एवं स्तुतः सुपर्णस्तु देवैः सर्षिगणैस्तदा तेजसः प्रतिसंहारमात्मनः स चकार ह॥
en: O king of birds, we pray to you, be kind towards us. Bestow on us, O Bhagavan, benefit, fortune and happiness. Having been thus adored by all the celestials and Rishis, the bird, of beautiful feathers, diminished his own energy and splendour.

sa: व्यवहारोऽत्र कात्स्येन धर्मार्थीयः प्रकीर्तितः। विविधानां च दानानां फलयोगाः प्रकीर्तिताः॥
en: It then treats of the rules Dharma and Artha in detail, then the various rules of charity and its different merits.

sa: कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दश्यां रात्रावस्यां पुरोचनः। भवनस्य तव द्वारि प्रदास्यति हुताशनम्॥
en: Purochana will set fire to the door of your house on the night of the fourteenth day of the black fortnight.

sa: काम त मे मारुतस्तत्र वास: प्रक्रीडिताया विवृणोतु देवा भवेच मे मन्मथस्तत्र कार्ये सहायभूतस्तु तव प्रसादात्॥
en: Ocelestial ! when I shall be near the Rishi, Maruta (wind) should be there and rob me of my cloth. Manmatha (the god of love) should at your command help me in my this work.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तच्छ्रुत्वा मन्दपालस्तु वचस्तेषां दिवौकसाम्। क्व नु शीघ्रमपत्यं स्याद् बहुलं चेत्यचिन्तयत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having heard these words of the dwellers of heaven, Mandapala thought how he could obtain the largest number offspring within the shortest period of time.

sa: सिद्धर्षिचारणपथं जगामाथ वराप्सराः। सा कन्या दुहिता तस्या मत्स्या मत्स्यसगन्धिनी॥
en: The excellent Apsara then rose on the path trodden by Siddhas. Rishis and Charanas. The fish-smelling daughter of the fish-form Apsara.

sa: गन्धर्व उवाच एवमुक्तः पुलस्त्येन वसिष्ठेन च धीमता। तदा समापयामास सत्रं शाक्तो महामुनिः॥
en: The Gandharva said : Having been thus addressed by Pulastya and the intelligent Vasishtha, the great Rishi, the son of Shakti (Parashara), brought that sacrifice to an end.

sa: वैशंपायन उवाच एवमुक्तवतीं तां तु प्रीतिमानृषिसत्तमः। उवाच मप्रियं त्वा कन्यैव त्वं भविष्यसि॥
en: Vaishampayana said : That best of Brahmanas, (Parashara), having been much pleased with all that she said, replied "you shall remain a virgin even after associating with me.

sa: सभवान् मोक्षयत्वस्मान् यत्नेनास्माद्भुताशनात्। अस्मास्विह हि दग्धेषु सकामः स्यात् सुयोधनः॥
en: Save us with exertion from the impending conflagration. If we are brunt to death, the desire of Duryodhana will be fulfilled.

sa: अथ कालस्य महत: स मुनिः संशितव्रतः। तपस्यभिरतो धीमान्स दारानाभ्यकांक्षत॥
en: Many years rolled away, but the Rishi of rigid vows, deeply engaged in ascetic devotions, did not seek for a wife.

sa: अलम्बुषः श्रुतायुश्च जलसन्धश्च वीर्यवान्। सौमदत्तिविराटश्च द्रुपदश्च महारथः॥ घटोत्कचादयश्चान्ये निहता द्रोणपर्वणि। अश्वत्थामाऽपि चात्रैव द्रोणे युधि निपातिते॥
en: In this Drona Parva is narrated the deaths of Alambusha, Shrutayus, valorous Jalasandha, Somdatti, Virata, great car-warrior Drupada, Ghatotkacha and others. Being exceedingly angry on account of the death of Drona in battle, Ashvathama also.

sa: व्याधिमिच्छामि ते ज्ञातुं प्रतिकुर्यां हि तत्र वै। एवमुक्तः स पुत्रेण शान्तनुः प्रत्यभाषत॥
en: I wish to know the disease from which you suffer, so that I may try to get a remedy." Having been thus addressed by his son, Shantanu replied,

sa: वीरिण्या सह संगम्य दक्षः प्राचेतसो मुनिः। आत्मतुल्यानजनयत् सहस्रं संशितव्रतान्॥
en: The Rishi Daksha, born of Prachetas, begot one thousand sons, uniting with Virini; they were all of rigid vows like himself.

sa: भरद्वाजोऽपि भगवानारुरोह दिवं तदा। तत्रैवं च वसन् द्रोणस्तपस्तेपे महातपाः॥
en: The illustrious Bharadvaja also (at this time) ascended heaven; thereupon, Drona continued to dwell in the hermitage) engaged in ascetic austerities.

sa: स कदाचित् क्षुधाविष्टो मृगयन् भक्ष्यमात्मनः। ददर्श सुपरिक्लिष्टः कस्मिंश्चिन्निर्जने वने।॥
en: One day becoming very much oppressed with exceeding hunger, he searched for some food. He saw in a certain solitary wood.

sa: तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा कोपेनाभिपरिवृतः। व्याहर्तुमुपचक्राम भार्गवो नहुषात्मजम्॥
en: Hearing the words of his daughter, Bhārgava, being enraged said to the king Yayāti.

sa: यत्राध्यायास्त्रयः प्रोक्ताः श्लोकानां च शतत्रयम्। विंशतिश्च तथा श्लोकाः संख्यातास्तत्त्वदर्शिना॥३६७।
en: There are three chapters in it and the number of slokas, composed by all truthknowing Vyasa, is three hundred and twenty.

sa: ऋतुकाले तु सम्प्राप्ते भर्तृव्यसनकर्शिता। अकृतार्था ह्यहं भर्ता प्रसवार्थं समागता॥
en: On my season's coming, I was united with my husband in order to get offspring; but I have not been successful.

sa: अलभद् गौतमी पुत्रमश्वत्थामानमेव च। स जातमात्रो व्यनदद् यथैवोच्चैःश्रवा हयः॥
en: The daughter of Gautama obtained a son, named Ashvathama; as soon as he was born, he neighed like the horse Uchaishrava.

sa: यथैव पाण्डोस्ते वीराः कुन्तीपुत्रा महारथाः। तथैव धर्मतः सर्वे मम पुत्रा न संशयः॥
en: There is no doubt that as those great carwarriors, the heroic sons of Kunti, are the sons of Pandu, so they are my sons also according to ordinance.

sa: यत्र यौधिष्ठिरं सैन्यं विषादमगमत् परम्। यत्र युद्धमभूद्घोरं दशाहानि सुदारुणम्॥
en: Then is narrated the great depression of the army of Yudhishthira and the fierce battle that raged for ten successive days.

sa: प्राची दिग् यज्ञवाहाश्च पावकाः सप्तविंशतिः। अग्नीषोमौ तथेन्द्राग्नी मित्रश्च सवितार्यमा॥
en: The eastern point, the twenty seven fires conveying the sacrificial Ghee, Agni, Soma, the fire of Indra, Mitra, Savitri and Aryama.

sa: अध्यायानां शतं प्रोक्तं षडशीतिर्महर्षिणा। श्लोकानां षट्सहस्राणि तावन्त्येव शतानि च॥ श्लोकाच नवतिः प्रोक्तास्तथैवाष्टौ महात्मना। व्यासेनोदारमतिना पर्वण्यस्मिंस्तपोधनाः॥
en: Great Rishis, the great Vyasa has composed this Parva in one hundred and eighty six chapters. The number of slokas composed in it by the great Rishi is six thousand six hundred and ninety eight.

sa: ततो द्रुपदमासाद्य भारद्वाजः प्रतापवान्। अब्रवीत् पुरुषव्याघ्रः सखायं विद्धि मामिति॥
en: Thereupon that powerful son of Bharadvaja went to that best of men Draupada and said, “Know me to be your friend."

sa: ते यज्ञसेनं दुपदं गृहीत्वा रणमूर्धनि। उपाजहः सहामात्यं द्रोणस्य भरतर्षभ।६३॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, thus seizing Yajnasena Drupada in the battle with his ministers, they offered him to Drona.

sa: योगेश्वरत्वं कृष्णेन यत्र राज्ञां प्रदर्शितम्। रथमारोप्य कृष्णेन यत्र कर्णोऽनुमन्त्रितः॥
en: Krishna's display of his Yoga powers to the kings; then his taking Karna on his chariot and giving him sound advice;

sa: यौ तु माद्री महेष्वासावसूत पुरुषोत्तमौ। अश्विभ्यां पुरुषव्याघ्राविमौ तावपि पश्यत॥
en: Look at these (two) best of men, the great bowmen, the twin boys, who were begotten by Ashvinis on Madri. VOW

sa: न चैनं कश्चिदारूढं लभते राजसत्तमम्। वातोऽपि निश्चरंस्तत्र प्रवेशे विनिवार्यते॥
en: None could approach that best of kings there (in that palace.) Even air could not go there, being prevented from entering.

sa: क्रूरबुद्धेरहं तस्य वचनादागता त्विह। अद्राक्षं नवहेमाभं तव पुत्रं महाबलम्॥
en: Coming here at the command of that cruelminded (Rakshasas), I saw your greatly powerful son of the colour of pure gold.

sa: त्रिषु लोकेषु न त्वासीत् कश्चिद् विदुरसम्मितः। धर्मनित्यस्तथा राजन् धर्मे च परमं गतः॥
en: O king, there was none in the three worlds, who excelled Vidura in his devotion towards religion and virtue and in his knowledge of the science of morality.

sa: तस्य कामात्मनः क्षेत्रे राज्ञः संयतवागृषिः। कृष्णद्वैपायन: साक्षाद् भगवान् मामजीजनत्॥
en: In the field of that lustful king, I was begotten by Krishna Dvaipayana of truthfull speech who was like Brahma himself.

sa: ययोरेव समं वित्तं ययोरेव समं श्रुतम्। तयोर्विवाहः सख्यं च न तु पुष्टविपुष्टयोः॥
en: Friendship or enmity, exists between two persons equally situated as to wealth or prowess. The poor and the rich can neither be friends nor enemies of each other.

sa: भ्रूणहत्यादिकं चापि पापं जह्यादसंशयम्। य इमं शुचिरध्यायं पठेत्पर्वणि पर्वणि॥
en: Even the sin of killing embryo is destroyed of those who read it with reverence at every change of the moon.

sa: कस्यचित् त्वथ कालस्य कंसो निर्मथ्य यादवान्। बार्हद्रथसुते देव्यावुपागच्छद् वृथामतिः॥
en: Sometime before, the foolish minded Kansa, having persecuted the Yadavas married two of the daughters of the son of Brihadratha (Jarasandha).

sa: क्रथस्तु राजनराजर्षिः क्षितौ जज्ञे महासुरः। पार्वतेय इति ख्यातः काञ्चनाचलसन्निभः॥
en: O king, the great Asura who was known as Kratha, became the royal sage Parvateya, as effulgent as a golden mountain.

sa: तं चारणसहस्राणां मुनीनामागमं तदा। श्रुत्वा नागपुरे नृणां विस्मयः समपद्यत॥
en: The citizens of Hastinapur were filed with wonder on hearing that thousands of Charanas and Rishis had arrived at their city.

sa: द्रौणेश्च द्रोहबुद्धित्वं वीक्ष्य पापात्मनस्तदा। द्रौणिद्वैपायनादीनां शापाश्चान्योन्यकारिताः॥
en: Seeing the wicked intention of Ashvathama, Dvaipayana cursed him and he too cursed Dvaipayana.

sa: अन्वेषमाणः सबलस्तं राजानं नृपोत्तमम्। अमात्यः सानुयात्रश्च तं ददर्श महावने॥
en: In searching that best of kings, that monarch's ministers and attendants saw him there in that state in the great forest.

sa: व्यवसितः; न प्रतिगृहीताश्च पाण्डवाः पितुर्निधनमावेदयन् तस्यौर्ध्वदेहिकं न्यायतश्च कृतवन्तः। तांस्तत्र निवसतः पाण्डवान् बाल्यात् प्रभृति दुर्योधनो नामर्षयत्॥
en: The Pandavas were, thereupon, accepted (by all). They then represented the death of their father and duly performed his obsequies. As they were brought up there in their boyhood, Duryodhana became very jealous of them.

sa: तत्र देवाः सगन्धर्वा गणैरप्सरसां वृताः। दिव्यतानैर्महाराज गायन्ति स्म सभागताः॥
en: O great king, there sing the celestials with the Gandharvas surrounded by various tribes of Apsaras in notes of celestials sweetness.

sa: वसिष्ठ उवाच कृतवीर्य इति ख्यातो बभूव पृथिवीपतिः॥ याज्यो वेदविदां लोके भृगूणां पार्थिवर्षभः।
en: Vasishtha said: There was a great king, known by the name of Kritavirya. That best of kings was in the world the disciple of the Veda knowing Bhrigus.

sa: ध्वजिनीमश्वसम्बाधां पदातिगजसंकुलाम्। अवस्थाप्य वनद्वारि सेनामिदमुवाच सः॥
en: Halting his army of flag-holders, cavalry, infantry and elephants at the out-skirt of the

sa: भीमसेनस्ततः श्रुत्वा प्रहसन्निव भारत। राक्षसं तमनादृत्य भुक्त एव पराङ्मुखः॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, hearing this Bhimasena smiled (in derision) and disregarding the Rakshasas and turning his head continued to eat.

sa: बाल्यात् प्रभृति कौरव्य सहाध्ययनमेव च। स मे सख्या सदा तत्र प्रियवादी प्रियंकरः॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, we had studied together from our earliest days; he was my friend from boyhood; he always spoke and did what was agreeable to me.

sa: एवं स राजा तं शापमुपभुज्यारिसूदनः। प्रतिलेभे पुना राज्यं प्रजाश्चैवान्वपालयत्॥
en: Having thus suffered the consequences of the curse, Saudasa, the slayer of enemies, again obtained his kingdom an governed his subjects.

sa: न शौरिणा विना पार्थो न शौरिः पाण्डवं विना। नाजेयोऽस्त्यनयोलोक कृष्णयोरिति मे मतिः॥
en: Partha (Arjuna) cannot live without Shauri (Krishna), and Shauri cannot live without Partha. My opinion is that there is nothing unconquerable by these two, namely Shauri and Partha.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच उपपन्नमिदं मातस्त्वया यद् बुद्धिपूर्वकम्। आर्तस्य ब्राह्मणस्यैतदनुक्रोशादिदं कृतम्॥
en: Yudhisthira said : O mother, what you have deliberately done, moved by the compassion for the affected Brahmana, is indeed excellent.

sa: स तेन पतगेन्द्रेण पक्षतुण्डनखक्षतैः। मुहूर्तमतुलं युद्धं कृत्वा विनिहतो युधि॥
en: But after a moment's fight he lay dead, mangled by the king of the birds with his beaks, talons and wings.

sa: ते समासाद्य कौन्तेयान् वारणावतका जनाः। कृत्वा जयाशिषः सर्वे परिवार्यावतस्थिरे॥
en: Coming to the sons of Kunti, the citizens of Varanavata surrounded them and blessed them by uttering the word Jaya (victory).

sa: अमन्यत स धर्मात्मा वसिष्ठं पितरं मुनिः। जन्मप्रभृति तस्मिंस्तु पितरीवान्ववर्तत॥
en: That virtuous-minded man (Parashara) knew from the day of his birth Vasishtha as his father and behaved towards him as such.

sa: तेषां तथैव तां लक्ष्मी सर्वक्षत्रमुपासते। इदानीमेव वै राजञ्जरासंधो महीपतिः॥
en: O king, all the Kshatriyas worship the wealth and prosperity of all these kings. At the present time the king Jarasandha,

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच पाण्डवान् धार्तराष्ट्रांश्च कृतास्त्रान् प्रसमीक्ष्य सः। गुर्वर्थं दक्षिणाकाले प्राप्तेऽमन्यत वै गुरुः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Seeing the sons of Pandu and Dhritarashtra accomplished in arms, Drona thought that the time had come when he could demand the preceptor's Dakshina (remuneration).

sa: तं प्रजाः प्रतिमोदन्त्यः सर्वाः प्रत्युद्गतास्तदा। विपाप्मानं महात्मानं दिवौकस इवेश्वरम्॥
en: The people came out in joy to receive the sinless and the illustrious one, as the celestials do their chief (Indra).

sa: श्रुत्वा तु पापसंयुक्तमात्मानं पुरुषर्षभ। किमुवाच नृगो राजा द्विजौ क्रोधसमन्वितौ॥
en: May I ask you, O foremost of men, what did that king say to the Brāhmaṇas when he saw thus imprecated?

sa: तस्य पुत्रद्वयं ब्रह्मन्द्वाभ्यां स्त्रीभ्यामजायत। अहं श्वेत इति ख्यातो यवीयान्सुरथोऽभवत्॥
en: His two queens gave birth to two sons. My name is Sveta and the name of my youngest brother was Suratha.

sa: कारयिष्यन्ति च मुदा यथा चेदिपतिर्नृपः। तेषां श्रीविजयश्चैव सराष्ट्राणां भविष्यति॥
en: And will observe this my festival like the king of Chedi, will gain wealth and victory for their countries and kingdoms.

sa: कुत एव महात्मानौ माद्रीपुत्रौ करिष्यत। तान् राज्यं पितृतः प्राप्तान् धृतराष्टो न मृष्यते॥
en: What these illustrious (princes) would do, the two sons of Madri will also do. They have inherited the kingdom from their father, but Dhritarashtra can not beat them.

sa: स्त्रीसकाशे च कौरव्य न पुमान् क्षन्तुमर्हति। धर्षणामात्मनः पश्यन् बाहुद्रविणमाश्रितः॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, no man, possessing strength of arms, ought to bear with patience any ill usage before his wife.

sa: तत् कौसल्यामिमामा" पुत्रशोकाभिपीडिताम्। वनमादाय भद्रं ते गच्छामि यदि मन्यसे॥
en: If you give me permission, I shall go to the forest with Kausalya, so grieved at the loss of her son."

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच किं चिकीर्षत्ययं कर्म भीमो भीमपराक्रमः। भवत्यनुमते कच्चित् स्वयं वा कर्तुमिच्छति॥
en: Yudhisthira said: What is the work that the greatly powerful Bhima wants to performs? Does he wish to do it by your command or of his own will?

sa: द्रोण उवाच कार्यं मे काक्षितं किंचिद्धदि सम्परिवर्तते। कृतास्त्रैस्तत् प्रदेयं मे तदेतद् वदतानघाः॥
en: Drona said: "O sinless ones, I have a particular desire in my heart; promise me truly that you will accomplish it when you will become skilled in arms.

sa: यां कृतां नानुकुर्वन्ति मानवाः प्रेक्ष्य विस्मिताः। मनुष्यलोके सकले तादृशीं कुरु वै सभाम्॥
en: Build such an assembly-hall that persons belonging to this world may not be able to build another like it, though he sits within it and observed it carefully.

sa: समवाये च युद्धस्य रामस्यागमनं स्मृतम्। सरस्वत्याश्च तीर्थानां पुण्यता परिकीर्तिता॥
en: The arrival of Balarama at the time of the fight is next described. Then is told the sacredness of the Sarasvati.

sa: तेषां समीपे यो देशो ह्रदानां रुधिराम्भसाम्। समन्तपञ्चकमिति पुण्यं तत्परिकीर्तितम्॥
en: The region, that lies near those five bloody lakes, has become famous from that day by the name of holy Samantapanchaka.

sa: गन्धर्व उवाच इदं वासिष्ठमाख्यानं पुराणं परिचक्षते। पार्थं सर्वेषु लोकेषु यथावत् तन्निबोध मे॥
en: The Gandharva said : O Partha, this history of Vasishtha is considered as a Purana in all the worlds. Listen to me as I recite it in detail.

sa: वर्तमानं हि धर्मेषु सर्वधर्मभृतां वरम्। तं महीषा महीपालं राजराज्येऽभ्यषेचयन्॥
en: All the kings of the earth, seeing him devoted to all kinds of virtues, installed him as the king of kings.

sa: गत्वा तु सरयूतोयं स्थावराणि चराणि च। प्राप्य तत्तोयविक्लेदं देवलोकमुपागमन्॥
en: And going to the waters of Sarayü all objects, mobile and immobile, having bathed there, repaired to the excellent celestial region.

sa: पृथक् पृथग् दिव्यदृशां पुनर्ददौ तदा धनं सौमकिरग्निसाक्षिकम्। तथैव वस्त्राणि विभूषणानि प्रभावयुक्तानि महानुभावः॥
en: Making fire his witness, the high-souled king of the lunar race, (Draupada), gave separately each of those celestials-like heroes much wealth, various brilliant ornaments and many costly robes.

sa: तं माता पुनरेवान्यमेकं पुत्रमयाचता तथेति च महर्षिस्तां मातरं प्रत्यभाषत॥
en: His mother (Satyavati hearing this) begged again for another son. The Rishi replied to his mother by saying, “Be it so."

sa: नष्टां गां क्षुधातॊ वै अन्विषंस्तत्र तत्र ह। नापश्यत्सर्वराष्ट्रेषु संवत्सरगणान्बूहन्॥
en: Undergoing hunger and thirst, the master of that cow travelled for a long time in many places in search of it.

sa: एतामक्षौहिणी प्राहुः संख्यातत्त्वविदो जनाः। यां वः कथितवानस्मि विस्तरेण तपोधनाः॥
en: Those who are acquainted with the Principle of number call the above, explained fully by me, the numbers of an Akshauhini.

sa: एवं प्राप्य पुरं रम्यं दुराधर्षं समन्ततः। अर्थसिद्धिं त्वनुपमा जरासंधोऽभिमन्यते॥ लोध्राणां च शुभाः
en: Having secured such a charming and impregnable city, Jarasandha does not fear to accomplish all his unrivalled purposes. We shall, however, today humble his pride by attacking him.

sa: शकुन्तलोवाच यदि धर्मपथस्त्वेष यदि चात्मा प्रभुर्मम। प्रदाने पौरवश्रेष्ठ शृणु मे समयं प्रभो॥
en: Shakuntala said: ( best of the Puru race, if this are the dictates of the scriptures and if I am really my own disposer, know then my terms.

sa: ततः प्रत्यागतप्राणा तावुभौ परिदंशितौ। पुत्रौ दृष्ट्वा सुसम्भ्रान्ता नान्वपद्यत किंचन॥
en: O being revived she was seized with fear on seeing her two sons clad in armour, but she could do nothing.

sa: ददामि ते वैजयन्तीं मालामम्लानपङ्कजाम्। धारयिष्यति संग्रामे या त्वां शस्त्रैरविक्षतम्॥
en: I shall also give you a victory producing garland of unfading lotuses, wearing which you shall not be wounded by weapons.

sa: गन्धर्व उवाच एवमुक्तः स विप्रर्षिर्वसिष्ठेन महात्मना। न्ययच्छदात्मनः क्रोधं सर्वलोकपराभवात्॥
en: The Gandharva said : Having been thus addressed by the illustrious Vasishtha, the Brahmana Rishi (Parashara) controlled his word destroying wrath.

sa: वानराश्च स्विकां योनिमृक्षाश्चैव तथा ययुः॥ येभ्यो विनिःसृताः सर्वे सुरेभ्यः सुरसंभवाः। तेषु प्रविविशे चैव सुग्रीवः सूर्यमण्डलम्॥ पश्यतां सर्वदेवानां स्वान्पितॄन्प्रतिपेदिरे।
en: The monkeys and bears shall enter into their respective celestial forms. They shall enter into the deities from whom they had respectively originated. Sugriva shall enter into the Sun's region. And they shall obtain their respective fathers' forms among the celestials present.

sa: सा सेना शीघ्रमागच्छच्छुत्वा शत्रुघ्नशासनम्। निवेशनं च शत्रुघ्नः श्रावणेन समारभत्॥
en: When the soldiers arrived there on hearing the commands of Satrughna he engaged in making encampments in the month of Śrāvan.

sa: कथयिष्याम्यशेषेण सर्वपापप्रणाशनम्। आस्तीकस्य पिता ह्यासीत्प्रजापतिसमः प्रभुः॥
en: (Listen) to this all sin-destroying history. Astika's father was as powerful as the Prajapati.

sa: यस्य रुष्यसि वै राम तस्य मृत्युर्विधावति। गीयसे तेन वै राम यम इत्यभिविक्रमः॥ यश्चैष मानुषो भावो भवतो नृपसत्तम। आनृशंस्यपरो राजा सत्त्वेषु क्षमयान्वितः॥ दुर्बलस्य त्वनाथस्य राजा भवति वै बलम्। अचक्षुषोत्तमं चक्षुरगतेः स गतिर्भवान्॥ अस्माकमपि नाथस्त्वं श्रूयतां मम धार्मिक। ममालयं प्रविष्टस्तु गृध्रो मां बाधते नृप।॥ त्वं हि देव मनुष्येषु शास्ता वै नरपुंगव।
en: O Rāghava, death pursues him with whom you are offended and it is for this reason that you are styled by people 'the highly powerful Yama. O foremost o kings, because you are forgiving to all creatures and a kind king that people sing your glories as of a man on earth. The king is the strength of the weak and helpless and he is the eye of the blind and the refuge of those who have no shelter. You are also our king: therefore do you listen to our petition. O king, entering into my nest, this vulture is oppressing me. You only, O foremost of men, are the divine chastiser of mankind.

sa: सौतिरुवाच महदाख्यानमास्तीकं यथैतत्प्रोच्यते द्विजः। सर्वमेतदशेषेण शृणु मे वदतां वर॥
en: Sauti said: O best of speakers, the story of Astika is very long, I shall relate it in full. O Listen.

sa: दीर्घजिह्वस्तुकौरव्य य उक्तो दानवर्षभः। काशिराजः स विख्यातः पृथिव्यां पृथिवीपते॥
en: O king of the Kuru race, that best of the Danayas who was known as Dirgajihva, became king Kashiraja on earth.

sa: अस्त्रवर्षेण महता वध्यमानं बलं तदा। प्रभग्नं सर्वतस्त्रस्तं विश्वामित्रस्य पश्यतः॥
en: Assailed with a great shower of weapons, Vishvamitra's troops before his very sight broke and fled panic stricken in all directions.

sa: न मानुषीणां जठरं प्रविशेम वयं शुभे। इत्युक्ता तैश्च वसुभिस्तथेत्युक्त्वाब्रवीदिदम्॥
en: O amiable one, we are unwilling to enter the womb of any human female.” Having been thus addressed she said :

sa: स राम मन्त्रिमध्यस्थं पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननम्। पश्यन्नमरमध्यस्थं सहस्रनयनं यथा।।।। सोऽभिवाद्य महात्मानं ज्वलन्तमिव तेजसा। उवाच प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा रामं सत्यपराक्रमम्॥
en: He espied there Rāma in the midst of the councillors like Indra among the immortals burning in his own effulgence. And having bowed with folded hands to Răma, having truth for his prowess, Śatrughna, said.

sa: तस्मादेवं विजानीहि कुरूणां वंशवर्धन। ब्राह्मणप्रमुखं राज्यं शक्यं पालयितुं चिरम्॥
en: O spreader of the Kuru race, therefore, know that the kingdoms with Brahmanas at their heads can be retained for long.

sa: स चापि तद् व्यदधात् सर्वमेव ततः सर्वे सम्बभूबुर्धरण्याम्। स चापि केशौ हरिरुद्धबह शुक्लमेकमपरं चापि कृष्णम्॥
en: He (Narayana) approved of everything and then they (Indras) all took births in the world of men. Hari (Narayana) took up two hairs from his body; one of then was white and the other black.

sa: प्रतीपस्य त्रयः पुत्रा जज्ञिरे भरतर्षभ। देवापिः शान्तनुश्चैव बाह्लीकश्च महारथः॥ देवापिश्च प्रवव्राज तेषां धर्महितेप्सया। शान्तनुश्च महीं लेभे बाह्रीकश्च महारथः॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, Pratipa begot three sons, namely Devapi, Shantanu and mighty car-warrior Balhika. Devapi adopted asceticism, impelled by the desire to do good to his brothers. Consequently the kingdom was obtained by Shantanu and the mighty carwarrior Balhika.

sa: एतद्वचो मया तत्र मुनिना व्याहृतं पुरा। श्रुतं हृदि च निक्षिप्तं नान्यथा तद्भविष्यति॥
en: I had heard there all there words of the great ascetic Durbāså. Up to this time they are lying in my heart. Rsis' words shall never prove fruitless.

sa: जरितोवाच किं नु ज्येष्ठेन ते कार्यं किमनन्तरजेन ते। किं वा मध्यमजातेन किं कनिष्ठेन वा पुनः॥
en: Jarita said: What business have you with the eldest of these (sons) and with him also who is the next and with him also who is the third and with him who is the youngest?

sa: ब्रह्मदत्तः स वै तस्य पाद्यमर्थ्य स्वयं नृपः। हार्द चैवाकरोत्तस्य भोजनार्थं महाद्युतेः॥ मांसमस्याभवत्तत्र आहारे तु महात्मनः। अथ क्रुद्धेन मुनिना शापो दत्तोऽस्य दारुणः॥ गृध्रस्त्वं भव वै राजन्मा मैनं ह्यथ सोऽब्रवीत्। प्रसादं कुरु धर्मज्ञ अज्ञानान्मे महाव्रत॥ शापस्यान्तं महाभाग क्रियतां वै ममानघ। तदज्ञानकृतं मत्वा राजानं मुनिरब्रवीत्॥ उत्पत्स्यति कुले राज्ञां रामो नाम महायशाः। इक्ष्वाकूणां महाभागो राजा राजीवलोचनः॥
en: Thereupon, offering that effulgent Brāhmaṇa, with his own hands, water to wash his feet the king Brahmadatta, made arrangements for his meal. Accidentally flesh was mixed with the food of the high-souled Gautama. Being enraged thereat, the ascetic imprecated him with a dreadful curse and said: "O king, you become a vulture.' The king said: 'Be propitiated, O you of great vows, do not imprecate me thus. I have out of ignorance committed this offence. O great one, O blameless one, do you act so that this curse may find termination.' Thereat understanding that this offence was committed by the king unwittingly, the ascetic said-'o king, in the race of Iksawkus a king shall be born under the name of Rāma.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा मूर्ध्नि शत्रुघ्नमुपाघ्राय महामतिः। आतिथ्यमकरोत्तस्य ये च तस्य पदानुगाः॥
en: Saying this the high-minded Vālmīki smelled his crown and made arrangements for his reception as well as that of his followers.

sa: ततो यमो दीक्षितस्तत्र राजन् नामारयत् कंचिदपि प्रजानाम्। ततः प्रजास्ता बहुला बभूवुः। कालातिपातान्मरणप्रहीणाः॥
en: O king, thus employed in that sacrifice, Yama did not kill any human being. Thereupon the death being suspended among men, the number of human beings greatly increased.

sa: तस्यामप्येकचक्रायां बकं नाम राक्षसं हत्वा पाञ्चालनगरमधिगताः॥
en: They killed at Ekachakra a Rakshasa, named Baka. They then went to Panchala city.

sa: रुरुरुवाच मम प्राणसमाभार्या दष्टासीद्भुजगेन ह। तत्र मे समयो घोर आत्मनोरग वै कृतः॥
en: Ruru said : My wife, who was as dear to me as my life, was bitten by a snake; on which I took, O snake, a fearful vow;

sa: स्वर्गते शान्तनौ भीष्मश्चित्राङ्गदमरिंदमम्। स्थापयामास वै राज्ये सत्यवत्या मते स्थितः॥
en: When Shantanu went to heaven, Bhishma, who was always obedient to Satyavati, installed that chastiser of foes, Chitrangada on the throne.

sa: इन्द्रप्रस्थनिवासं मे त्वं तत्रागत्य रंस्यसि। कुन्तीं युधिष्ठिरं भीमं भ्रातरौ मे कनीयसौ॥ आगत्य तत्र पश्येथा अन्यानपि च बान्धवान्। बान्धवैः सहिताः सर्वैनन्दसे त्वमनिन्दिते॥
en: In due course, you shall live extremely happily at our dwelling place Indraprastha. Reaching there, you shall get an opportunity to see my mother Kunti, Yudhisthira, Bhimsena, my younger brothers Nakula and Sahadeva and other relatives. O innocent lady! you shall be extremely pleased after meeting my all relatives.

sa: स कदाचिद्वनं विप्रो रुरुरभ्यागमन्महत्। शयानं तत्र चापश्यत् डुण्डुभं वयसान्वितम्॥
en: One day, the Brahmana, Ruru entered into a very large forest. He saw an old Dundubha snake lying on the ground.

sa: मन्त्रिणो भृत्यवर्गाश्च सपुत्रपशुबान्धवाः। सर्वे सहानुगा राममन्वगच्छन्प्रहृष्टवत्॥
en: The ministers and the servants, with their sons, beasts and friends, followed Rama delightedly.

sa: व्येतु ते मानसं दुःखं क्षत्रिया स्मो नरर्षभ। पद्मिनीव सुतेयं ते ह्रदादन्यह्रदं गता॥
en: O best of men, let grief be dispelled from your heart, we are Kshatriyas. Your daughter like a lotus has been transplanted from one lake to the other.

sa: बीजभूता वयं केचिदविशष्टा महामते। विवर्धेमहि राजेन्द्र प्रसादात् ते युधिष्ठिर।॥
en: O high-minded one, O Yudhishthira, we few only remain as seed. O king of kings, through your favour let us multiply.

sa: असहायेन रामेण वैदेही पुनराहता। हत्वा संख्ये दशग्रीवं राक्षसं भीमविक्रमम्॥
en: Again, the princess of Videha was rescued by Rama with almost no allies after having slain in battle the terribly-powerful ten-necked.

sa: विराटस्य तु कैकेयी भार्या परमसम्मता। आलोकयन्ती ददृशे प्रासादाद् द्रुपदात्मजाम्॥
en: While going abroad from the root of the palace Virata's beloved wife, the daughter of Kaikeyi, beheld the daughter of Drupada.

sa: दुपदो वर्धयन् मानं शिखण्डिपरिपालितः। उपायात् सर्वसैन्यानां प्रतिच्छाद्य तदा वपुः॥
en: And protected by Shikhandin has joined them after well protecting the limbs of his soldiers, enhancing the honour of the Pandavas.

sa: अवश्यं त्वेव वासार्थं रमणीयं शिवं सुखम्। सम्मन्त्र्य सहितैः सर्वैर्वस्तव्यमकुतोभयैः॥
en: After consulting together we must seek out a pleasant auspicious and agreeable place, where we may live all together without fear.

sa: स मुक्तोऽभ्येत्य राजानमभिवाद्य युधिष्ठिरम्। ववन्दे विह्वलो राजस्तांश्च दृष्ट्वा मुनींस्तदा॥
en: Being released he approached and bowed to the king Yudhishthira; and seeing the ascetics there, he, beside himself, saluted them all.

sa: तमन्वशासच्छत्रुनो रथे तिष्ठन् धनंजयः। अवरोपय वृक्षाग्राद् धनूंष्येतानि मा चिरम्॥
en: Dhananjaya, the slayer of enemies, waiting on the car, ordered him:-“Quickly bring down those bows from the top of the tree."

sa: सा भ्रात्रा प्रेषिता शीघ्रमगच्छन्नर्तनागृहम्। यत्रास्ते स महाबाहुश्छन्नः सत्रेण पाण्डवः॥
en: Sent by her brother she quickly went to the dancing hall where that mighty-armed son of Pandu was waiting in disguise.

sa: तदन्तरमथावृत्य कोटिकास्योऽभ्यहारयत्। महता रथवंशेन परिवार्य वृकोदरम्॥
en: Thereupon quickly encircling Vrikodara with mighty charioteers Kotikasya interposed between and separated the combatants.

sa: निवेश्योपवने सैन्यं तत् पुरः प्राज्ञवानरम्। प्रेषयामास दौत्येन रावणस्य ततोऽङ्गदम्॥
en: Having placed his army in the pleasuregardens of that city, Rama sent that wise monkey, Angada, as his envoy to Ravana.

sa: न चैतदनुरूपं ते यत् ते ग्लानिररिंदम। यदोजसा न लभते क्षत्रियो न तदश्नुते॥
en: This dullness which you evince is not fit for you; for a Kshatriya does not keep that which he does not win by force of his own might.

sa: निर्याय तस्मादुद्देशात् पश्यामो लवणाम्भसः। समीपे सह्यमलयौ दर्दुरं च महागिरिम्॥
en: And issuing out of the cave (we) beheld near the briny ocean the Sahya, the Malaya and the mighty Dardura mountains.

sa: स राजराजो लङ्कायां न्यवसन्नरवाहनः। राक्षसीः प्रददौ तिस्रः पितुर्वै परिचारिकाः॥
en: Living in Lanka that king of kings, borne on the shoulders of men, sent three Rakshasis to wait upon his father.

sa: तत एनं परिश्रान्तमुपलभ्य वृकोदरः। योक्त्रयामास बाहुभ्यां पशुं रशनया यथा॥
en: Thereupon on serving him greatly exhausted, Vrikodara bound him fast with his arms like one binding a beast with a rope.

sa: अर्जुनोत्सङ्गगौ पादौ केशवस्योपलक्षये। अर्जुनस्य च कृष्णायां सत्यायां च महात्मनः॥
en: On the lap of Arjuna were the feet of Keshava and those of the noble-minded Arjuna rested on Krishna and Satyabhama.

sa: आशीविषै रक्ष्यमाणं कुबैरदयितं भृशम्। यत् प्राप्य पुरुषो मर्योऽप्यमरत्वं नियच्छति॥
en: This was guarded by snakes, the favourite drink of Kubera, as it was drinking which even an earthy man gets immortality.

sa: अलं युद्धेन राजेन्द्र सुहृदां शृणु वारणम्। ध्रुवं विनाशो युद्धे हि क्षत्रियाणां प्रदृश्यते॥
en: War is not necessary, O chief among kings; listen to the dissuasion of your well wishers; sure destruction stares the Kshatriyas in the face in case of fight.

sa: बृहस्पतिसहायोऽसौ प्रविष्टो बलिनो मखे। तं दृष्ट्वा वामनतनुं प्रहष्टो बलिरब्रवीत्॥
en: With the help of Brihaspati he entered into the sacrificial ground of Bali. Beholding his dwarfish stature Bali laughed and said,

sa: कृत्वा कठिनभारं सा वृक्षशाखावलम्बिनम्। गृहीत्वा परशुं भर्तुः सकाशे पुनरागमत्॥
en: (Having said this), she hanging the bag on the branch of a tree and taking the hatchet, returned to her husband.

sa: स तानुवाच नहुषो देवानृषिगणंस्तथा। पितृभिः सहितान् राजन् परीप्सन हितमात्मनः॥
en: Thus, O king, did Nahusha, who wished their welfare, address the gods and the Rishis who were accompanied by our ancestors.

sa: विभीषण उवाच परमापद्गतस्यापि नाधर्मे मे मतिर्भवेत्। अशिक्षितं च भगवन् ब्रह्मास्त्रं प्रतिभातु मे॥
en: Vibhishana said: Even in great calamity may I have no inclination for impiety; ignorant, as I am, O lord, may the light of divine knowledge appear before me.

sa: जरासंधश्च वक्त्रश्च शिशुपालश्च वीर्यवान्। बाणश्च निहतः संख्ये राजानश्च निषूदिताः॥
en: Jarasandha, and Vakra and Shishupala of great heroism and Vana were slain by him in battle as also several other kings.

sa: चरन्तु देशान् संवीताः स्फीताञ्जानपदाकुलान्। तत्र गोष्ठीषु रम्यासु सिद्धप्रव्रजितेषु च।॥
en: Let them range all over the country, various provinces over-flowing with population, assemblies of learned men and charming retreats of ascetics.

sa: सर्वानेताननादृत्य दृष्ट्वा तमतिमानिनम्। तस्य मूर्ध्नि पतिष्यामि तत एते पराजिताः॥
en: Disregarding all these I shall find that vain wretch out and strike him down and then all these will be defeated.

sa: प्रगृह्यमाणा तु महाजवेन मुहुविनिःश्वस्य च राजपुत्री। सा कृष्यमाणा रथमारोह धौम्यस्य पादावभिवाद्य कृष्णा॥
en: But being seized by him again with great force the princess sighed again and again; then dragged by him Krishna, worshipping the feet of Dhaumya, ascended the car.

sa: स्वस्ति ते चान्तरिक्षेभ्यः पार्थिवेभ्यश्च पुत्रका दिव्येभ्यश्चैव भूतेभ्यस्तथा तोयचराश्च ये॥
en: "O son, may all the creatures inhabiting the firmament, the earth, the celestials regions and the water contribute to your welfare.

sa: एवमस्त्विति सावित्री ध्यानयोगपरायणा। मनसा ता गिरः सर्वा प्रत्यगृह्णात् तपस्विनाम्॥
en: Savitri, who was buried in contemplation, saying in her mind “be it so" bowed down to the words of the ascetics,

sa: अथाग्रजानन्तरजः पापभावानुरागवान्। ज्येष्ठं दुःशासनस्तत्र भ्राता भ्रातरमब्रवीत्॥
en: Thereupon his younger brother Dushasana, taking delight in sins, said before his elder brother.

sa: मम वा बाहुविक्षेपं शत्रूनिह विजेष्यतः। तस्माद् भूमिजयारोह शमीमेतां पलाशिनीम्॥
en: Heavy as it is when I grind the horses, elephants and the stretch of my arms when I defeat the enemies.

sa: न म्लायन्ति स्रजस्तेषां दिव्यगन्धा मनोरमाः। संयुज्यन्ते विमानैश्च ब्रह्मन्नेवंविधैश्च ते॥
en: There excellent garments full of celestial fragrance never fade. O Brahmana, there are such cars as this (one I have brought).

sa: विदुर उवाच तपो दमो ब्रह्मवित्तं वितानाः पुण्या विवाहाः सततान्नदानम्। येष्वेवैते सप्त गुणा वसन्ति सम्यग्वृत्तास्तानि महाकुलानि॥
en: Vidura said Devotion, self-control, knowledge in the Vedas, sacrificial ceremonies, marriages in proper form and incessant gift of food, the families, in which these seven practices exist in proper forms, are consider to be high.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पाञ्चाल्यः शिखण्डी च महारथः। युधामन्युश्च विक्रान्तो देवैरपि दुरासदः॥
en: Dhrishtadyumna, the princess of Panchala and the great car-warriors Shikhandi and the powerful Yudhamanyu hard to withstand even by the gods.

sa: किं च तेन मयोक्तेन यान्यभाषत कौरवः। संक्षेपेण दुरात्मासौ न युक्तं त्वयि वर्तते॥
en: What is the use of my repeating everything that the son of Kuru said; in brief that evilsouled one does not hold the opinion, you deserve, of yourself.

sa: आयसेन स दण्डेन रथान् नागान् नरान् हयान्। हनिष्यति रणे क्रुद्धो रौद्रः क्रूरपराक्रमः॥
en: Easily by means of his mace, the chariots, the elephants, men and horses he will kill in battle, that terrible being when wrathful, that man of cruel purposes.

sa: श्रुत्वा तु रावणस्तेभ्यः प्रहस्तं निहतं युधि। धूम्राक्षं च महेष्वासं ससैन्यं वानरर्षभैः॥ सुदीर्घमिव निःश्वस्य समुत्पत्य वरासनात्। उवाच कुम्भकर्णस्य कर्मकालोऽयमागतः॥
en: Hearing from them that the valiant monkeys, had in battle, killed Prahasta and the mighty bowman Dhumraksha together with (all) their forces, Ravana drawing a heavy sigh and rising from his excellent throne said, "The time for Kumbhakarna to act, is come."

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच एवमाश्वासितस्तैस्तु सत्यवाग्भिस्तपस्विभिः। तांस्तान् विगणयन् सर्वांस्ततः स्थिर इवाभवत्॥
en: Markandeya said : Thus consoled by those truthful sages and reflecting on the words they said, Dyumatsena became a little pacified.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच यानिहाहुः स्वस्य धर्मस्य लोकान् द्विजातीनां पुण्यकृतां सनातनान्। तेषां क्रमान् कथय ततोऽपि चान्यान् नैतद् विद्वन् वेत्तुमिच्छामि कर्म॥
en: Dhritarashtra said Those ancient and sacred regions of this „rn by their own virtuous acts-speak of them according to their degree (of sacredness). Speak also of other (sinless) regions. O learned one, I do not desire to know (the merit) of actions.

sa: समागमेन पुत्रस्य सावित्र्या दर्शनेन च। चक्षुषश्चात्मनो लाभात् त्रिभिर्दिष्ट्या विवर्धसे॥
en: Your meeting with your son, your sight of Savitri and your restoration to sight, these three blessing will make you prosper.

sa: वृत्ततस्त्वविहीनानि कुलान्यल्पधनान्यपि। कुलसंख्यां च गच्छन्ति कर्षन्ति च महद् यशः॥
en: Families, that are not of bad manners, though possessing but little wealth, are reckoned among families; and they win great fame.

sa: न च भीष्मस्य दुर्मेधाः शृणोति विदुरस्य वा। मम वा भाषितं किंचित् सर्वमेवातिवर्तते॥
en: That man of bad intellect does not even listen to the words of Bhima nor to those of Vidura nor even the words spoken by me-he disobeys all.
